about: Tracks every upstream Ice (jordanbaird/Ice) issue triaged for Icey. Scripts/build-site.py turns it into docs/upstream-issues.md and the website. Edit this file, never the generated page. status: fixed | partial | open | not-a-bug | feature. fixed_in: the Icey release tag that ships the fix, or null if it is not released yet. pr: the Icey pull request with the fix.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar item reverts to its previous position after being dragged
issues.headline: A menu bar item moves back after you drag it
issues.symptom: An item shown from the Ice Bar or search and then Command-dragged to a new place went back to its old position when the items were hidden again.
issues.fix: Icey notices that you moved the item and leaves it where you put it.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar appearance overlay for the built-in display is drawn on an external display as a solid black rectangle
issues.headline: The built-in display's menu bar tint shows as a black bar on an external display
issues.symptom: With an external display arranged beside the built-in one, the built-in display's menu bar appearance was drawn as a solid bar on the external display, above all windows.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display hides itself, then tries again to show on its own display instead of waiting for the next space change.
issues.note: Same cause as #858 and #910. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Bug]: Check for update dialog broken
issues.headline: The update dialog's buttons don't respond
issues.symptom: The "Check for updates automatically?" prompt ignored clicks and came back on every launch.
issues.fix: Icey brings the prompt to the front so it takes clicks and remembers your answer.
issues.note: Same as #681. Ice 0.11.12 reads Ice's own update feed, so it never offers Icey. Install Icey from its releases page.

issues.title: Ice has noticeable energy impact during mouse movement
issues.headline: Ice uses energy every time you move the mouse
issues.symptom: Moving the mouse raised Ice's energy use in Activity Monitor, even with "Show on hover" turned off.
issues.fix: Icey only listens to mouse, scroll and drag events while a setting that needs them is on.

issues.title: Energy impact
issues.headline: Ice has a high energy impact in Activity Monitor
issues.symptom: Ice showed a high energy impact in Activity Monitor during normal use.
issues.fix: Icey stops listening to system-wide mouse events it doesn't need, so it stays near zero energy impact while idle.

issues.title: High CPU usage
issues.headline: Ice uses a lot of CPU after switching apps
issues.symptom: With menu bar appearance settings on, Ice's CPU use spiked after every app switch, because it polled the app menu every millisecond.
issues.fix: Icey polls with a back-off, and only for the split shape, which needs the app menu's width.

issues.title: memory leak in WindowServer caused by Ice?
issues.headline: WindowServer memory grows while Ice runs
issues.symptom: After the Ice Bar was shown once, Ice captured the menu bar every 5 seconds forever, which kept WindowServer busy and growing.
issues.fix: Icey only captures the menu bar while the Ice Bar is visible, and only captures the wallpaper for shapes that draw it.
issues.note: Icey takes far fewer captures. A WindowServer leak inside macOS itself can't be ruled out.

issues.title: high memory usage
issues.headline: Ice's memory use grows over time
issues.symptom: Ice's memory grew over long runtimes.
issues.fix: A screen capture leak is fixed, and the menu bar item image cache is pruned instead of growing without limit.

issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.fix: Accessibility calls now give up after 1 second, and stuck item moves and clicks time out and retry.

issues.title: With an app item among the system items, clicking the battery opens that app and Wi-Fi does not open

issues.note: Early macOS 27 support.

issues.fix: Icey now captures the wallpaper with the system's dimming layer, so the colors match.

issues.title: Ice icon dissappeared

issues.fix: The layout pane now says what's wrong and how to get the icon back.

issues.title: Unable to proceed past permissions request.
issues.headline: Ice keeps asking for a permission that is already enabled
issues.symptom: System Settings showed Accessibility or Screen Recording as enabled, but Ice still asked for it.
issues.fix: The permissions window has a Reset and Ask Again button that removes the old entry and asks again, so macOS prompts afresh. If that fails, remove the app from the list in System Settings, then add it again. Screen Recording granted while Icey runs takes effect without a relaunch.

issues.title: Menu bar scaling and layout issues on external/built-in displays

issues.fix: Item images now use the scale of the display they were captured on.

issues.title: Ice Bar icons shrink drastically when expanded on an external display
issues.headline: Ice Bar icons shrink on an external display

issues.title: Ice appears to have caused system-wide freeze & kernel panic after ~33 hours of uptime
issues.headline: System freeze after long uptime with Ice running
issues.symptom: A Mac froze after about 33 hours of uptime with Ice running. Ice retried moving an item every 3 seconds forever when it couldn't put it back.
issues.fix: The crashing code from Ice 0.11.12 is gone. Retries now back off and stop after five rounds, and Icey recovers when its divider reappears.
issues.note: The freeze itself hasn't been reproduced.

issues.title: MacOS Tahoe 26.5 update broke hidden elements in ice layout
issues.headline: Hidden items are shown as always-hidden after macOS Tahoe 26.5
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 26.5, every hidden item showed up in the always-hidden section, and items dragged back to Hidden fell back into Always-Hidden.
issues.fix: When the always-hidden divider ends up on the wrong side, Icey now moves it left of the items that were hidden, and it saves where its dividers are when it quits.
issues.note: Same cause as #702. Not reproduced on 26.5.

issues.title: When icon for Intego One is moved from hidden to visible bar in settings, the icon disappears
issues.headline: An app's icon disappears when moved from hidden to visible
issues.symptom: Moving Intego One's icon from the hidden to the visible section made it disappear.
issues.fix: After a failed move, the pane now redraws instead of dropping the icon.
issues.note: The slow response looks specific to Intego.

issues.title: Removed icon from tray and can't get it back
issues.headline: Ice's icon was removed from the menu bar and won't come back

issues.title: App opens in dock when expanding the bar
issues.headline: A Dock icon appears when you show hidden items
issues.symptom: Showing hidden items made the app appear in the Dock for a moment.
issues.fix: This is how "Hide application menus" works: it makes the app active for a moment. Turn that setting off, or use the Ice Bar.

issues.title: Orphaned application menu-bar windows stuck at CGWindow layer 101, invisible to accessibility
issues.headline: Orphaned menu bar windows stuck at layer 101
issues.symptom: Invisible menu bar windows stayed on screen.
issues.fix: Not caused by Ice: the reporter saw it with the setting off and after removing Ice.

issues.title: OneDrive icons
issues.headline: OneDrive icons move to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: OneDrive's icons ended up in the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Some apps don't remember their item positions, so macOS places them in the always-hidden section. See the frequent issues page.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice triggering while clicking just under the menu bar in fullscreen
issues.headline: Clicking just under the menu bar in fullscreen triggers Ice
issues.symptom: In fullscreen, clicking just below the hidden menu bar showed the hidden items.
issues.fix: The top of a fullscreen display counts as the menu bar only while its menu bar is showing: with the Icey icon on another display, and now also with the Icey icon turned off.

issues.symptom: With "Use Ice Bar" on, the bar only showed "Unable to display menu bar items" or kept loading; with it off, Ice worked.

issues.symptom: Docker for Mac's item, and in the comments other hidden items, moved into the always-hidden section over time.
issues.fix: Same fixes as #702: the dividers keep their places across restarts, and fixing their order no longer empties the hidden section. Icey also remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow live activities to show
issues.headline: Allow Live Activities to show
issues.symptom: A request for Live Activities to stay visible.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar layout in settings bug
issues.headline: Layout pane doesn't show the visible and hidden sections' apps
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout didn't show any apps in the visible or hidden section for arranging.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu Bar Item Stuck After Ice Bar Click When Live Activities are Active
issues.headline: An item opened from the Ice Bar stays in the menu bar for good
issues.symptom: While iPhone Live Activities were in the menu bar, an item clicked in the Ice Bar stayed in the visible section and never hid again until Ice was restarted.
issues.fix: After moving a shown item back, Icey now checks that it really is back in its section and moves it there if not.
issues.note: The link to Live Activities is inferred from the code.

issues.title: [Bug]: Chevron separator is always shown
issues.headline: Hide the chevron separator
issues.symptom: A request to hide the divider while items are shown.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Bartender 3 mode
issues.headline: Bartender 3 mode
issues.symptom: A request for a Bartender 3 style layout.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Clicking on center of menu bar reveals the desktop
issues.headline: Click the middle of the menu bar to show the desktop
issues.symptom: A request for a click action that shows the desktop.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: App icon opens on hover
issues.headline: An app opens when hovering the menu bar
issues.symptom: Ice became the active app and showed in the Dock when hidden items were shown.
issues.fix: This comes from "Hide application menus": Icey must become the active app for a moment, which shows its Dock icon. Turn that setting off, or use the Ice Bar.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide Ice icon from dock
issues.headline: Hide the Ice icon from the Dock
issues.symptom: A request to keep the app out of the Dock.
issues.fix: Settings > Advanced > "Show Icey in the Dock while Settings is open" can be turned off to keep Icey out of the Dock and the app switcher.

issues.title: [Bug]: Icons don’t stay at its place - they flip after restart (Sequoia & Tahoe)
issues.headline: Arranged icons flip places after a restart
issues.symptom: Arranged icons swapped places after every restart, on macOS 15 and 26.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering positions is a feature request (#6, #26).

issues.title: [Bug]: Latest Tahoe Beta update gives Ice error, Ice freezes
issues.headline: Ice errors and freezes on a macOS 26.1 beta
issues.symptom: Ice showed an error instead of the hidden items, then stopped responding to clicks on its icon.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.

issues.title: [Bug]: Volume/brightness HUD not visible when Ice is running on macOS Tahoe
issues.headline: Volume and brightness pop-up not visible on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, the volume and brightness pop-ups didn't appear while Ice was running.
issues.fix: macOS 26 shows these pop-ups under their menu bar items, so they can't be seen while the items are hidden. Keep Sound and Display in the visible section.

issues.title: [Bug]: Cannot hide its icon when using game mode
issues.headline: Game Mode item can't be hidden
issues.symptom: The Game Mode item couldn't be hidden, and clicking Icey's icon didn't show hidden items while a game ran.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The Game Mode item is a system item.

issues.title: [Bug]: Show on swipe works but not scroll
issues.headline: Show on scroll works with a trackpad but not with a mouse wheel
issues.symptom: With the Ice Bar and "Show on scroll" on, a two-finger swipe on the trackpad opened the bar, but scrolling a mouse wheel did nothing.
issues.fix: Mouse wheel scrolling in the menu bar now shows and hides items too.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu Bar Layout BLANK (can't see any icons)
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is blank in every appearance mode
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 26.0, Menu Bar Layout showed no icons in light, dark or auto appearance.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again and keeps the pane readable when the menu bar color can't be read.

issues.title: [Bug]: If a system menu icon/text winds up in the notch area, it simply disappears!
issues.headline: Items in the notch area disappear
issues.symptom: Items that ended up behind the notch were not shown.
issues.fix: macOS hides items that fall behind the notch. Hide some items so the rest fit.

issues.title: [Bug]: Show Ice bar on hover should not trigger in Mission Control view
issues.headline: Show on hover triggers in Mission Control
issues.symptom: Moving the pointer to the top of the screen in Mission Control opened the Ice Bar or showed the hidden items.
issues.fix: Icey recognizes when Mission Control is open and doesn't show hidden items on hover or click while it is.
issues.note: There is no public way to detect Mission Control. Icey looks for the extra full-display window the Dock shows, measured on macOS 26.5.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Blacklist instead of whitelist strategy
issues.headline: Hide new items by default instead of showing them
issues.symptom: A request for a blacklist instead of a whitelist.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Hidden.
issues.note: Same request as #938.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Localize Ice
issues.headline: Localize Ice
issues.symptom: A request to translate the app's interface.
issues.fix: Icey is available in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. macOS picks the language from System Settings > General > Language & Region.

issues.title: [Bug]: "Unable to display menu bar items" | macOS Tahoe Version 26.0 (25A354) | Ice 0.11.13-dev.2
issues.headline: "Unable to display menu bar items" with the Ice Bar on macOS 26.0
issues.symptom: With the Ice Bar on, hovering or clicking the menu bar showed "Unable to display menu bar items" instead of the hidden items.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Ice Bar shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice shows "Unable to display menu bar item" under macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.headline: "Unable to display menu bar item" in settings and the menu bar
issues.symptom: In both Ice's settings and the menu bar, items were replaced by "Unable to display menu bar item".
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Bar and Show on Hover hovering area detection bug when system menu bar is on auto-hide mode
issues.headline: Show on hover and the Ice Bar misbehave when the menu bar hides automatically
issues.symptom: With the menu bar set to hide automatically, only the very top edge of the screen showed hidden items, and the Ice Bar or the shown items closed as soon as the pointer moved.
issues.fix: Icey now treats the whole revealed menu bar as the menu bar, so hover, click and timed rehide work as they do with a menu bar that is always shown.
issues.note: On a display other than the one with the Icey icon, only the top edge still counts. Not yet tested with an auto-hiding menu bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: When using Cloudflare WARP with Ice, the WARP GUI is malfunctioning until iCE is restarted.
issues.headline: Cloudflare WARP misbehaves until Ice restarts
issues.symptom: After a reboot, Cloudflare WARP's window didn't work from Ice until Ice was restarted.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: No cause found. Icey reloads items when apps launch or their item windows change.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow clear shape kind
issues.headline: Clear shape option
issues.symptom: A request for a transparent shape.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: menu bar items (iphone notifications) cannot be moved
issues.headline: iPhone notification items can't be moved
issues.symptom: Moving an iPhone Live Activity item failed with "took too long to respond".
issues.fix: When an item never responds to being moved, the alert now says the item didn't move and that some items, such as iPhone Live Activities, may not allow being moved.
issues.note: Icey still can't move these items. Whether macOS allows moving them is unconfirmed.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Ice Bar only on Macs with a Notch
issues.headline: Ice Bar only on Macs with a notch
issues.symptom: A request to turn on the Ice Bar only for Macs whose display has a notch.
issues.fix: Settings > General > Use Ice Bar > Use on: choose All displays, Displays with a notch, or Built-in display. Other displays show hidden items in the menu bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden items randomly moved to always hidden items
issues.headline: Hidden items randomly move to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: All hidden items sometimes moved into the always-hidden section at once.
issues.fix: When the always-hidden divider ends up on the wrong side, Icey now moves it left of the items that were hidden, instead of right next to the hidden divider, which pushed every hidden item into always-hidden. Icey also saves where its dividers are when it quits, so they come back in the same places.
issues.note: What puts the dividers in the wrong order in the first place isn't confirmed.

issues.title: [Bug]: Volume UI hidden on change if menu bar icon is hidden
issues.headline: Volume pop-up is hidden when the Sound item is hidden
issues.symptom: With the Sound item hidden, changing the volume showed no pop-up.
issues.fix: macOS 26 shows the pop-up under the Sound item. Keep Sound in the visible section.

issues.title: [Bug]: Check for updates stuck in Tahoe
issues.headline: Update check gets stuck on macOS 26
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 26, the automatic updates popup appeared at launch, and neither its buttons nor its checkbox worked.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, takes clicks and remembers your answer.

issues.title: [Bug]: On Tahoe, Items appear different sizes across monitor and laptop screen
issues.headline: Items are different sizes on the monitor and the laptop on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, items appeared at different sizes on the external monitor and the laptop screen.
issues.fix: Item images now use the scale of the display they were captured on.
issues.note: Same cause as #987 and #929. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Bug]: Make Lungo/Dato work with Ice
issues.headline: Lungo and Dato don't work with Ice
issues.symptom: Lungo and Dato didn't open while Ice was running.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The report has no details.

issues.title: [Bug]: nothing showing up in the menu editing
issues.headline: Nothing shows up in the menu editor on macOS 26
issues.symptom: The menu editing pane was empty.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: ICE window opens on ICE menubar click + at login
issues.headline: Ice settings window opens when clicking the Ice icon and at login
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, Ice 0.11.12 opened its settings window at login and whenever you clicked its icon.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, which fixes this.

issues.title: [Bug]: Once opened does not go back again
issues.headline: Hidden items don't hide again after clicking the icon
issues.symptom: After clicking the Ice icon, the hidden items stayed in the menu bar and didn't collapse again.
issues.fix: Icey no longer has the crash that stopped Ice from hiding the items again.
issues.note: The 0.11.13-dev.2 part (item stays shown) is likely fixed by the item helper and move timeouts. Please retest.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow unhide all when the display is larger
issues.headline: Show all items on larger displays
issues.symptom: A request to unhide everything when the display is large.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: stuck on automative update page on macOS 26
issues.headline: Ice is stuck on the update check page
issues.symptom: On first launch, nothing on the update availability page responded, and Ice had to be force quit.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, takes clicks and remembers your answer.

issues.title: [Bug]: Doesn't display menu bar layout
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout keeps saying "Loading menu bar items"
issues.symptom: The layout pane said "Loading menu bar items" and never showed them.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, and says what's wrong when its divider is missing.

issues.title: [Bug]: <bug title>Ice bar won't let me choose app
issues.headline: Ice Bar won't let you choose an app
issues.symptom: The Ice Bar went away before an app in it could be chosen.
issues.fix: The Ice Bar's area now counts as inside the menu bar, so it stays open while you move to it and use it.

issues.title: Whitened sections in Menu Bar Layout
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout sections turn white on macOS 26
issues.symptom: The Visible and Hidden sections under Menu Bar Layout were white.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again and keeps the pane readable when the menu bar color can't be read.

issues.title: [Bug]: (Tahoe Beta) Hover affects across screens
issues.headline: Hover on one screen affects other screens
issues.symptom: Showing hidden items on one display showed them on every display.
issues.fix: macOS mirrors menu bar items on every display, so a section is shown everywhere at once.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Menebar Layout Pane>
issues.headline: All three layout sections are empty
issues.symptom: The Menu Bar Layout pane's three sections showed no icons, so nothing could be arranged.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: "Check for updates automatically?" dialog buttons unresponsive
issues.headline: "Check for updates automatically?" buttons don't respond
issues.symptom: Neither "Don't Check" nor "Check Automatically" responded to clicks, and the checkbox had no effect.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, takes clicks and remembers your answer.

issues.title: [Bug]: "Unable to display menu bar items" on macOS Tahoe/Ice 0.11.13-dev.2
issues.headline: "Unable to display menu bar items" in the layout pane and Ice Bar
issues.symptom: With 0.11.13-dev.2 on macOS 26.0, the layout pane and the Ice icon's bar showed "Unable to display menu bar items", with all permissions granted.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice bar do not work:endless loading menu bar items
issues.headline: Ice Bar keeps loading menu bar items forever
issues.symptom: With 0.11.13-dev.2 on macOS 26.0, the Ice Bar never finished loading items, although the first beta worked.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Ice Bar shows them.

issues.title: [Bug]: Empty space on the left side of the right menu bar when split, MacOS Tahoe
issues.headline: Split menu bar keeps blank space on the left of the right half
issues.symptom: The split shape's right half reaches further left than the items.
issues.fix: The right half of the split shape was as wide as every item window on the display added together, counting overlapping windows and items from other displays. It now runs from the right edge to the last item in the row.
issues.note: Not yet tested on macOS 26 with this setup.

issues.title: [Bug]: Always Hidden Icons Disappeared.
issues.headline: Always-hidden icons disappeared on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, items in the always-hidden section disappeared from the menu bar.
issues.fix: Turn the apps back on in System Settings > Menu Bar > Allow in Menu Bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Search Not Working, Mac OS Tahoe
issues.headline: Search shows no items on macOS 26
issues.symptom: The search panel showed no items, either when opened or when searching.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so search lists them.

issues.title: [Bug]: unexpected closure
issues.headline: Ice closes unexpectedly when its icon is clicked
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 26, clicking the Ice icon made it disappear with an "unexpected closure" message.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.

issues.title: [Bug]: <crashes on MACOS  26 tahoe 26>
issues.headline: Ice crashes when unhiding icons on macOS 26
issues.symptom: Clicking Ice to show hidden icons showed them, then Ice quit unexpectedly.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.

issues.title: [Bug]: Search Items issues
issues.headline: Search shows items as "Item-0" and the wrong icons
issues.symptom: Search listed items with placeholder names, and icons could be hard to see.
issues.fix: Icey identifies item owners on macOS 26 again, and search draws icons on the menu bar's color.

issues.title: [Bug]: Items that change become hidden
issues.headline: An item that changes becomes hidden
issues.symptom: SwiftBar's now-playing item moved to the hidden section every so often.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering positions is a feature request (#6, #26).

issues.title: [Bug]: MacOS Tahoe Makes Ice Bar Invisible
issues.headline: Ice Bar is invisible on macOS 26
issues.symptom: With the Ice Bar on, it was invisible on hover, and with the Ice icon location, Ice crashed.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.

issues.title: [Bug]: MacOS Tahoe Breaks Menu Bar Layout Editor
issues.headline: Menu bar layout editor is all white on macOS 26
issues.symptom: The layout editor appeared entirely white, so items couldn't be arranged between sections.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again and keeps the pane readable when the menu bar color can't be read.

issues.title: [Bug]: When visible section application is updated, it will go to hidden section.
issues.headline: An updated app's item moves to the hidden section
issues.symptom: When an app in the visible section was updated, its item moved to the hidden section.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering positions is a feature request (#6, #26).

issues.title: [Bug]: <MacOS Tahoe> the bar appearance shows a slight shadow on top on the screen
issues.headline: Slight shadow at the top of the screen on macOS 26
issues.symptom: A faint shadow appeared at the top of the screen with the appearance settings on.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: No cause found beyond the earlier fix to the darkening behind the menu bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Getting focused out while playing league>
issues.headline: Games lose focus while Ice runs
issues.symptom: A fullscreen game lost keyboard focus while Ice was running.
issues.fix: Not fixed yet.
issues.note: One candidate, not confirmed: showing hidden items with "Hide application menus" on makes Icey the active app.

issues.title: [Bug]: the Menu Bar's height with "Shape kind = full" is a few pixels too short on second monitor
issues.headline: Full shape is a few pixels too short on a second display
issues.symptom: The full shape is slightly shorter than the menu bar on displays without a notch.
issues.fix: Shapes with square ends now fill the menu bar's full height on displays without a notch, as they already did on notched displays.
issues.note: Not yet checked on an external display.

issues.title: [Bug]: <macOS Tahoe> Cannot move live activities across sections
issues.headline: Live Activities can't be moved between sections
issues.symptom: Live Activity items couldn't be moved between sections on macOS 26.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Same as #704. The alert now explains that the item didn't move. Needs the item's details from Icey's log to tell whether macOS blocks moving it.

issues.title: [Bug]: ICE - Some Apps icons not appearing in the Menu Bar Layout setting
issues.headline: Some apps are missing from the layout pane
issues.symptom: Some apps' items didn't show in Menu Bar Layout on macOS 15.
issues.fix: An item touching a divider at a fractional position on a scaled display was in no section and was left out of the layout pane and the Ice Bar. Icey now allows the same small tolerance it uses for moves.
issues.note: May not be the reporter's cause; please retest.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow the tint option to affect the menubar background only and add transparency slider to colour swatch(es)
issues.headline: Tint only the menu bar background, with transparency

issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.fix: Not fixed yet.

issues.symptom: With the menu bar shown on one display only, moving the pointer or clicking near the top of the second display activated Ice, and right-clicking there opened Ice's menu.
issues.fix: With "Displays have separate Spaces" off, Icey now ignores the top of displays that have no menu bar.
issues.note: Not yet tested on a multi-display setup.

issues.title: [Bug]: menubar periodical glitch every 'x' minutes
issues.headline: Menu bar glitches every few minutes
issues.symptom: The menu bar flickered periodically.
issues.fix: Control Center relaunching itself causes this, not Ice.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Option-Click works randomly>
issues.headline: Option-click works randomly
issues.symptom: Option-clicking sometimes didn't show the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Option-click and Control-click now look only at Shift, Control, Option and Command, read from the click itself, so Caps Lock or the Fn key no longer turn them into a plain click.
issues.note: The Caps Lock and Fn cause comes from the code, not a reproduction.

issues.title: [Bug]: Completely lost Stats app when dragging into Menu Bar Layout section
issues.headline: Stats app lost after dragging it in Menu Bar Layout
issues.symptom: After dragging Stats into a section in Menu Bar Layout, its items were gone from the menu bar.
issues.fix: Turn Stats back on in System Settings > Menu Bar > Allow in Menu Bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Clicking on BusyCal Menu in hidden section opened Apple Menu instead
issues.headline: Clicking BusyCal in the hidden section opened the Apple menu
issues.symptom: Clicking BusyCal in the Ice Bar opened the Apple menu instead, and the Apple menu sometimes opened by itself.
issues.fix: Icey only clicks an item where it is when the item is on a display. Otherwise it shows the item first, and it never clicks at a point that is off every display.
issues.note: Fixes the most likely cause. The random Apple menu openings aren't confirmed fixed.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Support Ctrl+N and Ctrl+P to navigate down and up in the  menu bar items list
issues.headline: Ctrl-N and Ctrl-P in the search list
issues.symptom: A request for Emacs-style navigation in search.
issues.fix: In Search Menu Bar Items, Control-N and Control-P select the next and previous item, like the arrow keys.

issues.title: [Bug]: Strange Mouse Behavior After Clicking Hidden Icon
issues.headline: Pointer behaves strangely after clicking a hidden icon
issues.symptom: After clicking a hidden item on a macOS 26 beta, the pointer stayed an arrow everywhere until restart.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Quitting Ice didn't fix it and Bartender showed the same thing, which points to a macOS beta bug.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar on multiple displays
issues.headline: Right-click on a browser tab on a second display opens Ice's menu
issues.symptom: On a Mac Studio with three displays and the menu bar on one, right-clicking a Chrome tab at the top of another display opened Ice's menu instead of Chrome's.
issues.fix: Icey now ignores clicks at the top of displays that have no menu bar.
issues.note: Not yet tested on a multi-display setup.

issues.title: Can it support the multilingual version?

issues.symptom: A request whether a multilingual version can be supported.
issues.fix: Icey is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and follows the Mac's language settings.

issues.headline: Can't restore a removed chevron icon

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Auto-Sort behavior for "Unrecognized" Apps
issues.headline: Auto-sort unrecognized apps
issues.symptom: A request to choose where unknown items go.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Small-rounded variant for the Menu Bar Shape
issues.headline: Small rounded menu bar shape
issues.symptom: A request for a smaller corner radius.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: Random bar in the middle of the screen

issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.

issues.title: [Bug]: Split menu bar holds onto a large amount of blank space to the

issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The Ice Bar already closes when the menu bar slides away.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Disable functionality behind notch
issues.headline: Disable features behind the notch
issues.symptom: A request to turn off Ice in the notch area.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: App launches, then immediately crashes, on macOS Tahoe Beta 3
issues.headline: Ice crashes at launch on a macOS 26 beta
issues.symptom: On a 2022 MacBook Pro with a macOS 26 beta, Ice appeared for a split second and then crashed.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the later macOS 26 code, which no longer has the conversions that crashed.
issues.note: Crash log is unsymbolicated; matches the same family of crashes.

issues.fix: Option-click now shows the hidden section when there is no always-hidden section.

issues.title: App duplicates itself in dock on Tahoe
issues.headline: Ice appears twice in the Dock on macOS 26
issues.symptom: After clicking the menu bar a few times, Ice showed up twice in the Dock and couldn't be force quit.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, which no longer crashes or hangs when the menu bar is clicked.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu items disappear when there is no room left
issues.headline: Items disappear when there is no room left
issues.symptom: Items disappeared when the menu bar was full.
issues.fix: macOS drops items that don't fit. Hide some items, or reduce item spacing.

issues.title: [Bug]: protonvpn app icon presses itself when it hides itself after being opened from ice bar
issues.headline: ProtonVPN item clicks itself after being hidden
issues.symptom: ProtonVPN's item clicked itself when it was hidden again after being opened from the Ice Bar.
issues.fix: When moving an item, Icey no longer sends an extra mouse release after the item has moved, so hiding it again shouldn't click it.
issues.note: Same cause as #766. The other report, that clicking it in the Ice Bar didn't open it, isn't addressed.

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS 26 application menu change to ice empty menu when clicking on empty space on menu bar to expand collapse items
issues.headline: App menu changes to Ice's empty menu when showing items
issues.symptom: The menu bar showed Ice's empty menus after showing hidden items.
issues.fix: This comes from "Hide application menus": Icey must become the active app for a moment, which shows its Dock icon. Turn that setting off, or use the Ice Bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: <UI Bar Appearing on Main Display When Playing Fullscreen Video on Extended Display>
issues.headline: Menu bar shape appears on the main display during fullscreen video
issues.symptom: Playing a video fullscreen on the built-in screen made a bar appear on the main external monitor.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Not yet confirmed on two displays. Please retest in Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Widescreen Monitors Hidden Menu Always Visible
issues.headline: Hidden menu stays visible on widescreen monitors
issues.symptom: On a widescreen monitor, the hidden section's items stayed visible.
issues.fix: The split shape's right half no longer stretches across the hidden items. The items themselves still show.
issues.note: macOS limits how far a divider can push items to about 5,000 points, which is less than the width of this display.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: When bar items pass through the notch
issues.headline: Use the Ice Bar when items reach the notch
issues.symptom: A request to switch to the Ice Bar when items would be hidden by the notch.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: Clicking on the menus in some apps triggers Ice
issues.headline: Clicking app menus triggers Ice
issues.symptom: Clicking some apps' menus showed hidden items.
issues.fix: Show on click and show on hover now do nothing while an app's menu is open, so moving between its menus no longer shows the hidden items.
issues.note: The first click on a menu title still depends on measuring the app menus.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide/unhide using custom application whitelist
issues.headline: Hide or show items per app
issues.symptom: A request for a per-app whitelist.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice occasionally crashes.

issues.fix: The crash was an empty list in the code that shows a hidden item when Ice couldn't find its divider. Icey checks for that case and doesn't crash.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Automatically sort menu bar items in hidden section by name
issues.headline: Sort hidden items by name
issues.symptom: A request to sort the hidden section alphabetically.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Disable / alt settings with external monitor>

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Show menu bar item name on hover
issues.headline: Show an item's name on hover
issues.symptom: A request for tooltips with item names.
issues.fix: In the Ice Bar and Menu Bar Layout, hovering an item shows its name, and search lists items by name.
issues.note: Hovering an item in the menu bar itself shows whatever its app shows, which Icey can't change.

issues.headline: Grid layout for the Ice Bar
issues.symptom: A request for a grid option.

issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.

issues.fix: Icey no longer draws appearance overlays on fullscreen spaces.

issues.headline: Split view breaks with extended screens
issues.symptom: With extended displays, the MacBook's split menu bar shape appeared in the middle of another display.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that ends up on another display now hides itself.
issues.note: Same fix as #910. Not confirmed with this display arrangement.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Round corners of clicked menu bar items
issues.headline: Round corners of clicked items
issues.symptom: A request for rounded highlights.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.headline: Split shape's right half is too long on an ultrawide display
issues.symptom: On an ultrawide screen, the right half of the split shape was longer than its items.
issues.fix: The right half of the split shape was as wide as every item window on the display added together, counting overlapping windows and items from other displays. It now runs from the right edge to the last item in the row.

issues.headline: Pin the Ice Bar location with the Ice icon hidden

issues.headline: Another app's brightness slider keeps disappearing

issues.headline: Split menu bar disabled on macOS 15.3.2
issues.symptom: After a macOS update, the split shape, borders and other appearance effects stopped working.
issues.fix: The appearance editor now says when Icey lacks the Screen Recording permission it needs to draw the appearance, links to it, and applies the appearance as soon as it's granted.
issues.note: macOS updates can make Screen Recording need approving again. Unconfirmed that this was the cause.

issues.title: [Bug]: Background visible when entering fullscreen on video. or other application
issues.headline: Wallpaper shows over fullscreen apps with the split shape
issues.symptom: Entering fullscreen video or another fullscreen app left the split shape's background visible.
issues.fix: Icey no longer draws appearance overlays on fullscreen spaces.

issues.fix: Not fixed yet.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden icons end up in the Visible section after some interactions
issues.headline: Hidden icons end up in the visible section
issues.symptom: An item opened from the Ice Bar sometimes stayed in the visible section.
issues.fix: Icey now checks that a shown item is back in its section after hiding it again, no longer waits forever when the item's app adds or recreates a menu bar item on click, and keeps retrying if the item is briefly missing. Quitting Icey while an item is shown now moves it back first.

issues.title: [Bug]: Lack of sync among windows
issues.headline: Ice freezes and windows get out of sync
issues.symptom: Icey froze and its show/hide state got out of sync after toggling it on several desktops.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The out-of-sync state looks like a result of the freeze. Icey's hang fixes may help. Please retest.

issues.title: [Bug]: Split bar doesn't reach top of scren
issues.headline: Split bar doesn't reach the top of the screen

issues.headline: Raycast integration

issues.fix: Icey can be controlled with icey:// links, for example icey://toggle-hidden or icey://search. Shortcuts, scripts, Raycast and Alfred can open them. The README lists every link.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Open 'Menu Bar Layout' from Right-Click
issues.headline: Open Menu Bar Layout from the right-click menu
issues.symptom: A request for a context menu entry.
issues.fix: Right-click an empty part of the menu bar and choose Edit Menu Bar Layout.

issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.headline: Use the Ice Bar for the always-hidden section

issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: Zoomed-in part of the screen sometimes jumps around when macOS Display Zoom is active (while running Ice)
issues.headline: Display Zoom jumps around while Ice runs
issues.symptom: With Zoom on, the zoomed area jumped when Icey moved items in the background.
issues.fix: Icey no longer moves items on its own while the screen is zoomed in. Shown items are hidden again, and new items placed, once you zoom out.

issues.headline: Hidden items show no images
issues.symptom: The hidden section sometimes showed no item images.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey already throws away blank captures and shows "Unable to display menu bar items" instead.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Better appearance for rounded menu bar
issues.headline: Better look for the rounded menu bar
issues.symptom: A request for rounded screen corners.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Option to enable showing hidden section when hovering over un-hidden side
issues.headline: Show hidden items when hovering the visible side
issues.symptom: A request for a wider hover area.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: Interaction with Alcove
issues.headline: Ice conflicts with Alcove
issues.symptom: Alcove's notch stopped reacting to hover while Ice was running.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey's overlay panels ignore mouse events and its hover monitor only listens, so no cause was found in the code.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar item spacing not applying correctly
issues.headline: Item spacing doesn't apply
issues.symptom: Changing item spacing had no effect.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey writes the same settings as the reporter's working commands and relaunches apps. Please retest.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Disable / Customize Menu Bar Appearance in Full Screen Mode
issues.headline: Turn off or customize the menu bar appearance in fullscreen
issues.symptom: A request to turn off or change the menu bar appearance in fullscreen mode, where it looked out of place.
issues.fix: Icey no longer draws appearance overlays on fullscreen spaces.

issues.title: [Bug]: 1Password menu item weirdness
issues.headline: 1Password's item moves between sections on its own
issues.symptom: 1Password's item moved from visible to hidden on its own, and moving it back failed with an error.
issues.fix: 1Password recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout; item moves in Icey now time out and retry.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Make the "Use Ice Bar" toggle dynamic
issues.headline: Turn on the Ice Bar automatically per display
issues.symptom: A request for a dynamic "Use Ice Bar" setting.
issues.fix: Settings > General > Use Ice Bar > Use on: choose All displays, Displays with a notch, or Built-in display. Other displays show hidden items in the menu bar.
issues.note: There is no automatic switch based on free space; the display rule covers the common notched laptop plus external display case.

issues.title: Keyboard Maestro will not move from hidden to visible
issues.headline: Keyboard Maestro can't be moved to visible
issues.symptom: Moving Keyboard Maestro's item to the visible section failed with an error on 0.11.12.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The move code has been rewritten since 0.11.12. Please retest.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice interferes with right-click on title bar on display where menu bar is not displayed
issues.headline: Right-clicking a window title on a display without a menu bar opens Ice's menu
issues.symptom: With "Displays have separate Spaces" off, right-clicking a document title or tab near the top of a secondary display also opened Ice's menu, and Ice's "Show on" settings swallowed clicks there.
issues.fix: Icey now ignores the top of displays that have no menu bar.
issues.note: Not yet tested on a multi-display setup.

issues.title: [Bug]: Automatically rehide takes affect even when inside a hidden items menu options
issues.headline: Rehide closes an open item menu
issues.symptom: Automatic rehide hid items while one of their menus was open.
issues.fix: Timed rehide and show on hover now wait while an item's menu or popover is open below the menu bar, instead of hiding the items and closing it.
issues.note: A menu bar app that keeps a window open under the menu bar all the time would also hold rehide off.

issues.title: [Bug]: Unexpected behavior after swiping between desktop and full screen apps
issues.headline: Split shape shows the wallpaper after swiping to a fullscreen app
issues.symptom: After swiping between the desktop and fullscreen apps, the split shape drew the wallpaper over the app.
issues.fix: Icey no longer draws appearance overlays on fullscreen spaces.

issues.title: Menu bar in middle of screen
issues.headline: Rounded menu bar appears in the middle of the screen after fullscreen
issues.symptom: After leaving a fullscreen window, the rounded menu bar shape appeared in the middle of the screen.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Not yet confirmed on two displays. Please retest in Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Large icons in Menu Bar Layout Settings
issues.headline: Icons are too large in the Menu Bar Layout pane
issues.symptom: Icons in the Menu Bar Layout settings were drawn much larger than in the menu bar.
issues.fix: Item images now use the scale of the display they were captured on.
issues.note: Same cause as #987 and #929. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Bug]: The Shazam (music recognition) icon is invisible all the time
issues.headline: Shazam item is always invisible
issues.symptom: The Music Recognition item couldn't be hidden or shown by Ice.
issues.fix: macOS before 15.3.2 doesn't let that item be hidden, so Icey leaves it alone.

issues.title: [Bug]: Glitch when toggle dock
issues.headline: Glitch when toggling the Dock
issues.symptom: Showing or hiding the Dock with Option-Command-D made the menu bar appearance flicker.
issues.fix: Icey no longer rebuilds the menu bar appearance when only the Dock changes, only when displays change.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hide Application Menus doesn't unless Enable always-hidden section is toggled on
issues.headline: "Hide application menus" only works with the always-hidden section on
issues.symptom: With the always-hidden section turned off, showing hidden items never hid the application menus, even when the items ran into them.
issues.fix: Icey now checks the items you just showed against the application menus, so the menus hide when they need to.
issues.note: Some reports where it also fails with the always-hidden section on have a different cause, tracked in #620 and #879.

issues.title: [Bug]: menubar icons disappear when active app menus extend to the right
issues.headline: Items disappear when app menus are long
issues.symptom: Items vanished when the active app's menus reached them.
issues.fix: macOS drops items that collide with app menus. Turn on "Hide application menus", which this release fixes for setups without the always-hidden section (#434).

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS Sequoia requires a restart of Ice to render the menubar border
issues.headline: Border needs an Ice restart after login on macOS 15
issues.symptom: The menu bar border didn't show until Ice was relaunched.
issues.fix: Icey now tries again for about two minutes when the menu bar isn't there yet at login, instead of giving up until the next space change.
issues.note: Not yet tested with a login on macOS 15.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow clicks inside the notch
issues.headline: Allow clicks inside the notch

issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: OneDrive changes from "Hidden" to "Visible" on click

issues.symptom: With a personal and a business OneDrive account, clicking one hidden OneDrive item left both items in the visible section for good.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Bar appears and will not disappear when using "Show on hover" with a delay set to 0

issues.symptom: With show on hover and a delay of 0, the Ice Bar appeared and never went away.

issues.title: [Bug]: Dock icon appears when using Always hidden feature.

issues.title: [Bug]: Disabling displays have separate spaces not working
