issues.symptom: After 1Password was relaunched, or its menu bar option was turned off and on, its item came back in the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering positions is a feature request (#6, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: Can't change the Menu Bar Layout
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout shows only white space on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On a macOS 26 beta, Menu Bar Layout showed only white space, and changes made by Command-dragging didn't show up there.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.
issues.note: Same as #743.

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS 26: Hiding an icon handicaps that app's features
issues.headline: Hidden apps' global shortcuts stop working on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On a macOS 26 beta, apps whose items were hidden stopped responding to their global shortcuts until the hidden items were shown again.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey only moves hidden items off screen. The Dock icon that shows when items are shown is #906 ("Hide application menus").

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS Tahoe 26 display failed
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is blank on macOS 26 in dark mode
issues.symptom: On a macOS 26 developer beta, Menu Bar Layout showed nothing, and switching to dark mode didn't help.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again and keeps the pane readable when the menu bar color can't be read.
issues.note: Same as #716.

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS 26: menu bar layout screen completely blank/white
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout and search are blank on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On a macOS 26 beta, Menu Bar Layout was completely white, and searching menu bar items showed nothing either.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the layout pane and search show them.
issues.note: Same as #743.

issues.title: RAM monitoring software in the  bar
issues.headline: Which app shows RAM usage in the menu bar
issues.symptom: A question about which app shows RAM usage in the menu bar, as seen in a screenshot.
issues.fix: Not an Ice issue. The app in the screenshot is Stats (github.com/exelban/stats).

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <feature title>When can you support Chinese?
issues.headline: Chinese translation
issues.symptom: A request for a Chinese version of the app.
issues.fix: Icey is available in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. macOS picks the language from System Settings > General > Language & Region.
issues.note: Same as #801.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Dynamically display icons
issues.headline: Show items only when their icon changes or a condition is met
issues.symptom: A request to show items such as Wi-Fi, VPN or Amphetamine only when their state changes.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #62.

issues.title: [Bug]: Persistent Issue: New Icons Default to "Always Hidden"
issues.headline: New menu bar items always go to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: New items always landed in the always-hidden section, and some items, such as Do Not Disturb, sometimes changed sections on their own.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden. Icey also saves where its dividers are when it quits and repairs them if they end up out of order.
issues.note: Same as #6. Random moves are #702, and system items set to "Show When Active" are #844.

issues.title: [Bug]: Dynamic items, such as Dato's menu bar notifications and Lyrics's menu lyrics, are consistently hidden.
issues.headline: Dato notifications and LyricsX lyrics always end up hidden
issues.symptom: Items that apps such as Dato and LyricsX add while running were always hidden, even after being placed in the visible section.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering positions is a feature request (#6, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: Discord little ball (notification when you're in a call) moves from the bar to hidden.
issues.headline: Discord's call indicator keeps moving to the hidden section
issues.symptom: Discord's call indicator moved to the hidden section every time a new call started.
issues.fix: Discord recreates its item for each call, and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering positions is a feature request (#6, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Optimize Battery Icon appearance>
issues.headline: Show the battery percentage inside the battery icon
issues.symptom: A request to put the battery percentage inside the battery icon, like on iOS.
issues.fix: Not planned. The battery icon belongs to macOS, and Icey can't change how system icons look.

issues.title: [Bug]: The DingTalk icon needs to be reconfigured every time it is restarted
issues.headline: DingTalk icon goes back to the hidden section after the app restarts
issues.symptom: After quitting and reopening DingTalk or OpenVPN Connect, its icon went back to the hidden section.
issues.fix: The app creates a new item each time it starts, and macOS places new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: <bug title> ShapeKind is not working
issues.headline: Menu bar shape setting doesn't work
issues.symptom: The report said the shape setting did not work but gave no details.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The report has no description.

issues.title: [Bug]: After restart, app icon always moves to "always-hidden" section
issues.headline: Remote Desktop Manager icon moves to the always-hidden section after a restart
issues.symptom: After restarting the Mac, Devolutions Remote Desktop Manager's icon was always in the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item at startup and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.note: Same as #344. If every hidden item moves at once, see #702.

issues.title: [Bug]: Position of menubar icons in hidden section are not remembered
issues.headline: Hidden items don't keep their place after their app restarts
issues.symptom: After quitting and reopening an app whose item was in the hidden section, the item came back outside the hidden section.
issues.fix: Where a restarted app's item appears is decided by the app and macOS. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: eul keep being sent to Always Hidden Section
issues.headline: eul moves to the always-hidden section at every login
issues.symptom: The eul item went back to the always-hidden section after every login.
issues.fix: eul recreates its item at login and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <feature title>语言选项
issues.headline: Chinese language option
issues.symptom: A request for a Chinese version of the app.
issues.fix: Icey is available in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. macOS picks the language from System Settings > General > Language & Region.
issues.note: Same as #801 and #787.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Keep icons which are only enabled while app is open shown!
issues.headline: Keep the place of items that only appear while their app is open
issues.symptom: A request to put Figma's item back in its place each time the app opens, instead of at the end.
issues.fix: Not started. Settings > General > New items appear in places items from apps Icey hasn't seen before, but only once, so an item that comes back each launch is not moved again.
issues.note: Related to #6 and #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Custom padding top & horizontally for pill shaped designs
issues.headline: Custom padding for rounded menu bar shapes
issues.symptom: A request for padding around the rounded menu bar shapes, which sit close to the screen edges.
issues.fix: Not started. Only the inset shape on notched screens is available, in Menu Bar Appearance > Use inset shape on screens with notch.
issues.note: On screens without a notch there is no room to inset the shape without covering items.

issues.title: [maybe Bug]: AirBattery Icon moves to always hidden
issues.headline: AirBattery item moves to the always-hidden section after sleep
issues.symptom: A pinned AirBattery device item went back to the always-hidden section after a while or after sleep.
issues.fix: AirBattery recreates the item and macOS puts new items at the far left. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.note: Same as #344. See also #732.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: introduce profiles to handle macbook's notch conditionally
issues.headline: Use the Ice Bar only on the notched built-in display
issues.symptom: A request to use the Ice Bar on the MacBook's notched display and the normal menu bar on an external monitor.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > General > Use Ice Bar > Use on, then choose Displays with a notch or Built-in display. Full profiles are not started.
issues.note: Upstream pointed to #26 and #62. Same setting as #555.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu renders incorrectly on secondary monitor in dual-screen setup
issues.headline: Gap on the second display when section dividers are hidden
issues.symptom: With section dividers turned off, showing hidden items left an empty gap where each divider is on the unfocused display.
issues.fix: Not fixed yet.
issues.note: Same as #241.

issues.title: [Bug]: MacBook Pro M4 w/ Notch - icons disappearing 'underneath' the notch I guess?
issues.headline: Icons disappear under the notch
issues.symptom: With many hidden items shown on a MacBook with a notch, some icons disappeared behind the notch.
issues.fix: macOS hides items that fall behind the notch. Turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar, and set Use on to Displays with a notch to use it only there.
issues.note: Same as #715. Switching to the Ice Bar automatically is #570.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow profiles
issues.headline: Switch between menu bar layout profiles
issues.symptom: A request for layout profiles such as Home and Travel.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #26.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden Items shown by menu bar on 57in monitor
issues.headline: Hidden items show on a 57 inch ultrawide monitor
issues.symptom: On a Samsung G9 57 inch monitor, the first hidden items showed next to the visible items.
issues.fix: Not fixed yet.
issues.note: Same as #94 and #573. macOS stops a divider at about 5,000 points, which is less than this display's width.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: bring up applications with shortcut
issues.headline: Keyboard shortcuts to open individual menu bar items
issues.symptom: A request for a shortcut that opens a specific item, such as Wi-Fi.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #291.

issues.title: [Bug]: New items default to always-hidden section
issues.headline: New menu bar items go to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: Items from newly launched apps appeared in the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden.
issues.note: Same as #767. Not available on macOS 27.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice bar floating in middle of screen after full screening an app
issues.headline: Menu bar shape floats in the middle of the external monitor after fullscreen
issues.symptom: With an external monitor and the split or full shape, a copy of the shape appeared in the middle of the screen when an app went fullscreen.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: ice bar disappeares when using onlyswitch menubar app
issues.headline: Ice icon disappears while OnlySwitch runs
issues.symptom: Ice's items disappeared while OnlySwitch was running.
issues.fix: Turn off Hide Menu Bar Icons in OnlySwitch's settings.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Laptop/Desktop Modes
issues.headline: Different hidden items on laptop and desktop
issues.symptom: A request for different layouts on the laptop screen and an external monitor.
issues.fix: Not started. Only the Ice Bar can differ per display, in Settings > General > Use Ice Bar > Use on.
issues.note: Same as #26.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Show menubar icons of new apps as visible by default
issues.headline: Show new menu bar items as visible by default
issues.symptom: A request for new apps' items to appear in the visible section.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible.
issues.note: Same as #767. Not available on macOS 27.

issues.title: [Bug]: "Ice can't display menu bar items for automatically hidden menu bars" error
issues.headline: "Can't display menu bar items for automatically hidden menu bars" error
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout and Menu Bar Appearance showed this error and could not be used.
issues.fix: In System Settings > Control Center, set Automatically hide and show the menu bar to In Full Screen Only or Never.
issues.note: Same as #201.

issues.title: [Bug]: App blocking option+a
issues.headline: Option-A stops working while Ice runs
issues.symptom: Option-A no longer typed å while Ice was running, because it was saved as the always-hidden section's hotkey while that section was turned off.
issues.fix: Icey no longer registers the always-hidden section's hotkey while that section is turned off, so its keys type normally again.
issues.note: The hotkey recorder is hidden while the section is off. Turn the section on to change or clear the hotkey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menubar item arrangement not sticking
issues.headline: BetterDisplay item loses its place after the app restarts
issues.symptom: After restarting BetterDisplay, its item went to the hidden section or to the end instead of where it was placed.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item and macOS places it. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. To choose where new items go, use Settings > General > New items appear in.
issues.note: Same as #344. The new item part is #767.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Add preference key to display certain default icons
issues.headline: Deploy a default set of shown icons with a configuration profile
issues.symptom: A request for an admin preference that sets which icons are shown on first launch.
issues.fix: Not started. Settings > Advanced > Export Settings and Import Settings move settings between Macs, but item order isn't included.
issues.note: Related to #26.

issues.title: "Search menu bar items" (command palette) lists "always-hidden" items, but nothing happens when you activate them (by pressing Enter)
issues.headline: Search can't open always-hidden items
issues.symptom: Pressing Enter on an always-hidden item in the search panel did nothing.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Search shows always-hidden items the same way as hidden ones, and that path was reworked in #513 and #729.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Group Menu Icon with notification count (sum of the app in the group)
issues.headline: Group icon with a combined notification count
issues.symptom: A request for one group icon that opens several apps and shows their total notification count.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #46. Apps don't share their notification counts with Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Automatic adding items when Ice bar is enabled>
issues.headline: Clicking an item in the Ice Bar moves it into the menu bar
issues.symptom: Clicking a hidden item in the Ice Bar showed it in the menu bar.
issues.fix: This is expected. An item must be in the menu bar to open its menu, and Icey hides it again shortly after.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide App Menu
issues.headline: Hide app menus on the left of the menu bar
issues.symptom: A request to hide app menus so only the Apple menu and app name show.
issues.fix: Partly available: Settings > Hotkeys > Toggle application menus, and Settings > Advanced > Hide app menus when showing menu bar items. Hiding single menus isn't possible because each app controls its own menus.

issues.title: [Bug]: <When in full screen, menu bar appears on top monitor>
issues.headline: Menu bar shape outline appears on the other monitor in fullscreen
issues.symptom: With the full or split shape, an outline of the menu bar appeared on the external monitor while an app was fullscreen on the MacBook.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Multiple ice bars (folders/menus)
issues.headline: Several Ice Bars as folders
issues.symptom: A request for several Ice Bars that each open a group of items.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #46.

issues.title: [Bug]: MacOS 26 crash when pressing the "more" button
issues.headline: Ice crashes on macOS 26 when you show hidden items
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, pressing the button that shows hidden items crashed Ice.
issues.fix: The code that crashed is gone, and similar conversions elsewhere no longer crash on unexpected values.
issues.note: Same cause as #977.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice stops working in Mac OS 26 Tahoe
issues.headline: Ice stops working on macOS 26 Tahoe when you expand the menu bar
issues.symptom: On macOS 26 Tahoe, clicking the dots to expand the menu bar made Ice stop working.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite and works on macOS 26.

issues.title: [Bug]: Searchbar-like Artefact Upon Full-Screen
issues.headline: Bar-shaped artefact on the external display when an app goes fullscreen
issues.symptom: On macOS Tahoe, making a window fullscreen on the built-in display left a bar-shaped artefact over all windows on the external display.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445 and #636. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Bug]: Not all icons are shown
issues.headline: Some items don't show next to the notch
issues.symptom: With the hidden section shown, only about 15 items appeared and the rest were missing.
issues.fix: macOS drops items that don't fit beside the notch. Turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar to show hidden items below the menu bar instead.
issues.note: Same cause as #589.

issues.title: [Bug]: Issues with F.lux when it's icon is hidden using Ice
issues.headline: f.lux doesn't turn its filter back on after full screen while its item is hidden
issues.symptom: With f.lux's item hidden, f.lux turned its filter off for a full screen video but didn't turn it back on afterwards.
issues.fix: Hidden items are moved off screen, and f.lux seems to need its item on screen for this. Keep f.lux in the visible section, or ask f.lux's developers about it.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Localization
issues.headline: Translate the app into other languages
issues.symptom: A request to translate the interface.
issues.fix: Icey is available in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. macOS picks the language from System Settings > General > Language & Region.
issues.note: Same as #230.

issues.title: [Bug]: Possible Menubar icon disappears when NORD VPN started?
issues.headline: An app's item disappears when NordVPN is turned on
issues.symptom: SugarSync's item disappeared and its sign-in was lost when NordVPN connected.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: SugarSync most likely quit when the VPN connected. Icey doesn't quit apps or remove their items.

issues.title: [Bug]: menu bar layout not recalling prior after restart
issues.headline: Menu bar layout isn't remembered after a restart
issues.symptom: After a restart, items were spread over the wrong sections and had to be arranged again.
issues.fix: Icey now saves where its icon and dividers are when it quits, and repairs them if they end up out of order, so items come back in their sections.
issues.note: Upstream closed it as #344. The whole layout changing at once is #769 and #702.

issues.title: [Bug]: menu background is placed wrong when using a second screem
issues.headline: Menu bar background appears in the wrong place with a second display
issues.symptom: With a second display, the menu bar shape or tint was drawn somewhere on the desktop, such as at the bottom of the screen.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: pause functionality when connected to big screen
issues.headline: Turn the Ice Bar or hiding off on a large external display
issues.symptom: A request to use Ice only on the notched built-in display, and to show every item on a large external display.
issues.fix: Settings > Displays has, for each display, Use Ice Bar (Follow, On or Off) and Show hidden items automatically. Settings > General > Use Ice Bar > Use on can also limit the Ice Bar to displays narrower than a width you set.

issues.title: [Bug]: Clicking on Other Networks in Wifi settings exits Ice Bar Menu
issues.headline: Wi-Fi menu closes when clicking Other Networks
issues.symptom: After opening Wi-Fi from the hidden items and clicking Other Networks, the menu closed and the items were hidden again.
issues.fix: A click inside a shown item's menu or panel no longer counts as a click outside the menu bar, so smart rehide doesn't close it while it is in use.
issues.note: Same fix as #621. Not tested with the Wi-Fi menu, and not reproduced with the Ice Bar.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Dim the menubar to work with hazeover harmoniously
issues.headline: HazeOver doesn't dim the menu bar appearance
issues.symptom: HazeOver's dimming didn't cover the area where Ice draws the menu bar appearance.
issues.fix: Icey draws the menu bar appearance at the menu bar's own window level, which is above HazeOver's dimming. Turn off the tint and shape in Menu Bar Appearance, or ask HazeOver's developer to dim above the menu bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Badgeify icons are placed in always hidden section
issues.headline: Badgeify items go back to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: Badgeify's items returned to the always-hidden section each time their app was reopened.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: The native Shazam icon can't be placed in Ice in MacOS Sequoia 15.1.1
issues.headline: Shazam's item can't be moved
issues.symptom: The Music Recognition (Shazam) item couldn't be moved and didn't appear in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.fix: macOS before 15.3.2 doesn't let that item be hidden, so Icey leaves it alone.
issues.note: Same as #440.

issues.title: [Bug]: <ice cannot arrange menubar items in automatically hidden menu bars>
issues.headline: Can't arrange items when the menu bar hides automatically
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout showed an error instead of the items when the menu bar was set to hide automatically.
issues.fix: Icey no longer blocks Menu Bar Layout, the Ice Bar or the appearance editor when the menu bar hides automatically.
issues.note: Upstream closed it as #201. Not yet tested with a menu bar that hides automatically.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Newly installed apps should have their icon put into the "Always visible" group, not into "always hidden">
issues.headline: New items go to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: Newly installed apps put their item in the always-hidden section, where it was hard to find.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden. Icey moves items from an app it hasn't seen before to that section once, and leaves them alone after that. Icey also remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Random play wallpaper support enhance
issues.headline: Menu bar shape changes abruptly when the wallpaper changes
issues.symptom: A request for a smooth transition when a rotating wallpaper changes, instead of an abrupt switch.
issues.fix: Not started. macOS no longer announces wallpaper changes, so Icey checks the wallpaper every few seconds and swaps it without a transition. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: <crash on macos15>
issues.headline: Crash at launch on a macOS 15 beta
issues.symptom: Ice crashed right after launch on an early macOS 15 beta.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The report came from a beta build of macOS 15.

issues.title: [Bug]: OpenVPN connect icon always returns to always hidden section
issues.headline: OpenVPN Connect's item keeps returning to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: OpenVPN Connect's item returned to the always-hidden section each time the app relaunched, and 1Password and Obsidian did the same.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: Doll: Position of an app is not remembered
issues.headline: Doll's items don't keep their position
issues.symptom: Items created by Doll moved to the hidden sections whenever their app restarted.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: NextDNS menu item doesn't stick after restart
issues.headline: NextDNS item moves to the hidden section after a restart
issues.symptom: NextDNS's item went back to the hidden section after every restart.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: Application update new version does not go back to menubar set
issues.headline: An app's item loses its section after the app updates
issues.symptom: After updating Shottr, its item didn't go back to the section it was in.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: Ice is not displaying Stats module
issues.headline: Stats item disappears next to the notch
issues.symptom: A Stats module placed at the far left of the visible section disappeared.
issues.fix: macOS drops items that don't fit beside the notch. Hide some items, reduce item spacing, or use the Ice Bar.
issues.note: Same cause as #589.

issues.title: [Bug]: Multiscreen setup when full screen app on 1 screen, the ice cutout display on other screen
issues.headline: Split shape shows on the other display after a full screen app
issues.symptom: With two displays, entering a full screen app on one showed a cutout of the split shape on the other.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Bug]: 1password app always be hidden automaticlly
issues.headline: 1Password moves to the hidden section
issues.symptom: 1Password's item went back to the hidden section after a few days or restarts.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Spacers!
issues.headline: Spacers between menu bar items
issues.symptom: A request for spacer items with a set width to group menu bar items.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #91.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide mouse cursor behind the notch without triggering the menu bar
issues.headline: Hide the pointer behind the notch without showing the menu bar
issues.symptom: A request to move the pointer behind the notch in a full screen app without the menu bar appearing.
issues.fix: Not planned. macOS shows the menu bar when the pointer reaches the top of a full screen app, and other apps can't change that.

issues.title: [Bug]: <bug title>Temporary Menubar items do not reappear in menu
issues.headline: Doll's badge items don't come back
issues.symptom: Doll's badge item was moved to the hidden section after it disappeared and came back.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Always hide Application Menus except app name
issues.headline: Hide app menus except the app name
issues.symptom: A request to hide every app menu except the app's name, to make room for menu bar items.

issues.note: Same as #49.

issues.title: [Feature Request]:
issues.headline: A fork of Ice that runs on macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.symptom: An announcement of another fork of Ice that runs on macOS 26 Tahoe, not a feature request.
issues.fix: Nothing to change in Icey. Icey supports macOS 26 Tahoe and macOS 27.

issues.title: [Bug]: Invisible tray icon in menu bar layout in macos tahoe
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is invisible on macOS 26.3.1
issues.symptom: On macOS 26.3.1, the Menu Bar Layout pane in Ice 0.11.12 was completely empty.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.
issues.note: Same as #891.

issues.title: [Bug]: Unclickable Update popup
issues.headline: The update window can't be clicked or closed
issues.symptom: On macOS 26.3, the update window ignored clicks and couldn't be closed.
issues.fix: Icey brings the prompt to the front so it takes clicks and remembers your answer.
issues.note: Same as #931. Ice 0.11.12 reads Ice's own update feed, so it never offers Icey. Install Icey from its releases page.

issues.title: [Bug]: 升级mac 26.2，没有拖拽的图标 in “Menu Bar Layout”
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout shows no icons on macOS 26.2
issues.symptom: On macOS 26.2, the Menu Bar Layout sections were white and showed no icons to drag.
issues.fix: Icey identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so the Menu Bar Layout pane shows them.
issues.note: Same as #891.

issues.title: [Bug]: How to uninstall Ice ?
issues.headline: How to uninstall Ice
issues.symptom: Ice wasn't in the Applications folder, so it couldn't be found to uninstall it.
issues.fix: The app had never been moved to Applications and was still in Downloads. Quit it and delete it from there.
issues.note: Same as #949.

issues.title: [Bug]: Tahoe -Ice menubar items missing on laptop screen compared to external monitor
issues.headline: Some items are missing on the notched laptop screen
issues.symptom: On a MacBook with a notch, several items shown on the external display were missing from the built-in display.
issues.fix: macOS drops items that don't fit beside the notch. Reduce item spacing, hide some items, or turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar for displays with a notch.
issues.note: Same cause as #589. The reporter fixed it by reducing item spacing.

issues.title: [Question]: Project abandoned?
issues.headline: Is Ice abandoned?
issues.symptom: Users asked whether Ice is still maintained and whether a stable macOS 26 release is coming.
issues.fix: Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it with releases for macOS 26 and 27.
issues.note: Same as #939.

issues.title: [Bug]: Keeps quitting on 26.0.1, menu bar layout sections black.
issues.headline: Ice quits when clicking its icon and the layout is black on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On macOS 26.0.1, Ice quit when its icon was clicked, the hidden items came back, and the Menu Bar Layout sections were black.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite and identifies menu bar items on macOS 26 again, so it no longer quits and the layout shows your items.
issues.note: Same as #684 and #743.

issues.title: [Bug]: Support for Tahoe?
issues.headline: Ice doesn't work properly on macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.symptom: On macOS 26 with Ice 0.11.12, Menu Bar Layout showed empty sections, and clicking the Ice icon put the menu bar back to normal.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.
issues.note: Same as #973.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Not support macOS Tahoe>
issues.headline: Ice crashes and items can't be dragged on macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, Ice 0.11.12 crashed when clicked, and items couldn't be dragged.
issues.fix: Same as #877. Icey is built on the macOS 26 code and fixes the crashes, so items can be arranged again.

issues.title: [Bug]: Scrolling on macOS Tahoe very slow with Ice running
issues.headline: Scrolling is slow on macOS 26 while Ice runs
issues.symptom: On macOS 26.0 with Ice 0.11.12, scrolling in every app was slow, and normal again without Ice.
issues.fix: Icey listens to scroll events only while Show on scroll is on. Ice listened to every scroll in the system all the time.
issues.note: Not confirmed by the reporter. macOS 26.0 also slowed scrolling in some Electron apps without Ice.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Bar Not working properly
issues.headline: Ice crashes when the Ice Bar is turned on in macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, Ice 0.11.12 crashed when the menu bar was clicked with the Ice Bar turned on.
issues.fix: Same as #840. Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.

issues.title: [Bug]: Black window popup on Tahoe with beta 0.11.13-dev.1 with Reduce Transparency turned on
issues.headline: The Ice Bar is solid black with Reduce Transparency on macOS 26
issues.symptom: With Reduce Transparency on, the Ice Bar in Ice 0.11.13-dev.1 was solid black and its icons couldn't be seen.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice 0.11.13-dev.2, which Icey is built on.
issues.note: The reporter couldn't confirm the fix. A custom Icey icon only follows light and dark mode if the option below the icon picker is on.

issues.title: [Bug]: Empty menu bar layout sections (MacOS 26 dev beta 5)
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout shows empty sections on a macOS 26 beta
issues.symptom: On a macOS 26 beta, the three sections in Menu Bar Layout were empty, though Command-drag still worked.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.
issues.note: Same as #973.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Provide basic functionality without screen recording
issues.headline: Use Ice without the Screen Recording permission
issues.symptom: A request to use Ice without granting Screen Recording, and to explain why it is needed.
issues.fix: Screen Recording is already optional. Skip it during setup. Hiding, showing and Command-dragging items still work, but the Ice Bar, Menu Bar Layout images, search images and the menu bar appearance need it.

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS 26 doesn't show anything in "Menu Bar Layout"
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is blank on macOS 26
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, the Menu Bar Layout pane showed three white bars instead of the menu bar items.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.
issues.note: Same as #973.

issues.title: [Bug]: No Always Hidden Section in Ice Settings
issues.headline: The always-hidden section is missing from Menu Bar Layout
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout had no always-hidden section, so some items could only be reached through search.
issues.fix: With the always-hidden section off, Menu Bar Layout now says so, with a link to Advanced settings, where Enable the always-hidden section turns it on.

issues.title: [Bug]: macOS is constantly telling me "Ice is Accessing Your Screen"
issues.headline: macOS keeps saying Ice is accessing your screen
issues.symptom: On macOS 15.2, the "Ice is accessing your screen" reminder appeared almost every time a menu bar item was clicked.
issues.fix: This is a macOS bug that also hits other screen capture apps. Install the app in Applications, not from the download folder, and if it continues, remove the quarantine flag with `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine` on the app.
issues.note: Screen Recording is optional. Without it, only the Ice Bar, the Menu Bar Layout images, search images and the menu bar appearance are lost.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu Bar items automatically show/hide when click on Application Menu Items
issues.headline: Clicking app menus shows and hides menu bar items
issues.symptom: Clicking an app's menus, except Finder's, showed and hid the hidden items.
issues.fix: Show on click and show on hover now do nothing while an app's menu is open, so moving between its menus no longer shows the hidden items.
issues.note: Same as #567. The reporter later said it no longer happened.

issues.title: [Bug]: Can't move menu items in Menu Bar Layout in Settings
issues.headline: "Do not press keys while moving menu bar items" when dragging in Menu Bar Layout
issues.symptom: Dragging items in Menu Bar Layout failed with "Do not press keys while moving menu bar items", though no key was pressed.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, which made the key check less strict in 0.11.12. Icey also no longer counts Caps Lock as a held key.
issues.note: The Caps Lock change shipped in v0.11.13-dev.2-icey.3 (#17).

issues.title: [Bug]: Segmentation Fault
issues.headline: Ice crashes at launch on a macOS 15 beta
issues.symptom: Ice 0.11.10 crashed with a segmentation fault at launch on a macOS 15 beta.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Ice 0.11.11 fixed the panel style the log warned about, and the crash that remained was inside macOS preferences code on a beta. No later reports.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hotkey for toggling Ice Bar
issues.headline: Keyboard shortcut to turn the Ice Bar on and off
issues.symptom: A request for a shortcut to switch the Ice Bar on and off without opening settings.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Set a shortcut for "Enable the Ice Bar" in Settings > Hotkeys.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden menu bar is exceedingly wide
issues.headline: The Ice Bar is wider than the screen
issues.symptom: The Ice Bar filled the whole screen width and scrolled, because another app's very wide hiding item was in the hidden section.
issues.fix: Icey draws any item at most 300 points wide in the Ice Bar and Menu Bar Layout, so another app's hiding item no longer stretches them.
issues.note: Not reproduced with BetterTouchTool.

issues.title: [Bug]: Unable to open Ice settings panel
issues.headline: Settings window doesn't open
issues.symptom: Choosing Ice Settings from the menu did nothing after a restart, until Ice was relaunched.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Settings opens from the Icey menu and the app icon.
issues.note: Same as #375.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Removing Gradient Stops
issues.headline: Remove a color stop from the gradient tint
issues.symptom: There was no visible way to remove a color stop from the menu bar gradient.
issues.fix: Right-click a color stop and choose Remove Color Stop, or select it and press Delete.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Freezing After a reinstall (Built-in upgrade, manually upgrade, downgrade...)
issues.headline: Ice freezes after updating or reinstalling
issues.symptom: After an update, downgrade or reinstall, Ice opened its settings and permissions windows but stopped responding. Relaunching didn't help.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found, and upstream couldn't reproduce it. Reporters fixed it by removing the app's settings, for example with AppCleaner, and installing again.

issues.title: [Bug]: Operation timed out for "Sound"
issues.headline: "Operation timed out" when moving the Sound item
issues.symptom: Moving an item in Menu Bar Layout failed with "Operation timed out", and the item disappeared until Ice was restarted.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Similar to #746. Apps that filter mouse events can block moves, and a restart cleared it for both reporters. Icey's move code retries up to 8 times with growing timeouts.

issues.title: [Bug]: ICE Bar flashes by upon click and disappears quickly
issues.headline: The Ice Bar flashes and disappears
issues.symptom: The Ice Bar appeared for a moment and closed when opened by click, hover or the menu.
issues.fix: Closed: the reporter said it went away on its own. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey keeps the Ice Bar open while the pointer moves to it (#813).

issues.title: [Bug]: Invisible large items in menu bar cause it to overflow and become scrollable
issues.headline: Invisible wide items make Menu Bar Layout scroll
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout showed very wide invisible items, so the sections overflowed and scrolled.
issues.fix: Menu Bar Layout draws any item at most 300 points wide, so another app's hiding item no longer makes it scroll.
issues.note: Same as #379. Not reproduced with BetterTouchTool.

issues.title: [Bug]: Can't hide Spotlight icon?
issues.headline: Spotlight item can't be hidden
issues.symptom: Moving the Spotlight item to the hidden section failed with "Could not complete" and left two Spotlight items.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, which reworked how items are moved. The reporter confirmed it on Ice 0.11.5.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Remove 1px padding around menu bar when using any menu bar shape
issues.headline: Thin gap above the menu bar with a menu bar shape
issues.symptom: With the full or split shape, a 1-pixel gap showed between the shape and the top of the screen.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Ice removed the gap on displays with a notch, and kept it on other displays, where the shape looked cut off without it.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Update Notes
issues.headline: Show release notes in the update window
issues.symptom: A request to see what changed in a new version before updating.
issues.fix: The update window lists the release notes of the new version, with its highlights, fixes and anything to do.

issues.title: Issue withdrawn
issues.headline: Right-click opens Ice's menu in fullscreen games
issues.symptom: Right-clicking at the top of the screen, in fullscreen games or on the Dock, opened Ice's "Edit Menu Bar Appearance" menu.
issues.fix: Same as #892. Turn off the right-click menu in Settings > Advanced. Icey also ignores clicks at the top of a fullscreen app when the menu bar is out of sight.
issues.note: The original report was withdrawn. This entry covers the comments.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Ability to add custom icons - for both light and dark mode
issues.headline: Custom Ice icon for light and dark mode
issues.symptom: A custom icon looked the same in light and dark mode, so it was hard to see on a dark menu bar.
issues.fix: Turn on Settings > General > Custom icon uses dynamic appearance. The icon then follows the menu bar's light or dark look.

issues.title: [Bug]: XXX is unresponsive (yellow exclamation) until Ice is quit and relaunched
issues.headline: A menu bar item shows as unresponsive until Ice restarts
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout showed a yellow warning and refused to move an item, saying its app was unresponsive, even though the app worked. It happened after the app was relaunched or rebuilt.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey asks the window server whether the app is unresponsive each time it draws the item, with the same check Activity Monitor uses. Please retest.

issues.title: [Bug]: On a MacBook with a notch, items on Ice Bar are unclickable if menu bar is full
issues.headline: Ice Bar items can't be clicked when the menu bar is full on a notched MacBook
issues.symptom: On a MacBook with a notch, clicking an Ice Bar item did nothing when the right side of the notch was full, because the item was moved behind the notch.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The clicked item is placed to the right of the notch, and if there is no room, a "Not enough room" alert says so.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Replace some visible items to show selected ice bar item
issues.headline: A wide item from the Ice Bar doesn't open when the menu bar is full
issues.symptom: Clicking a wide item, such as Stats, in the Ice Bar did nothing when the menu bar had no room for it.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The item is placed far enough right to clear the app menus and the notch, pushing visible items aside, and Icey says so when there is still no room.
issues.note: The notch case was upstream #259.

issues.title: [Bug]: clicking on icon in (floating) Ice Bar triggers app menu
issues.headline: Clicking an item in the Ice Bar opens the app's menus instead
issues.symptom: Clicking an item in the Ice Bar clicked a menu of the frontmost app, because the item was moved behind the app's menus.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey moves the clicked item to a spot right of the application menus and the notch before clicking it, and says so if there is not enough room.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice 0.10.1 release regression crash (Solution: BTT conflict)
issues.headline: Ice crashes when clicked with BetterTouchTool's menu bar hiding on
issues.symptom: Ice 0.10.1 crashed when its icon was clicked while BetterTouchTool was hiding menu bar items.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, in the release after 0.10.1.

issues.title: [Bug]: Missing and duplicate items in Menu Bar Items settings
issues.headline: Items are missing or duplicated in Menu Bar Layout
issues.symptom: On macOS 14, the Menu Bar Layout pane left out some items and showed others twice. Items moved to the always-hidden section also vanished.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The reporter confirmed it was gone after later Ice releases.
issues.note: The crash in the same report came from OnlySwitch's "Hide Menu Bar Icons" option. For duplicates on macOS 26, see #854.

issues.title: [Bug]: "The "visible" section in settings "Menu Bar Items" is only available if Ice icon is activated in "General"
issues.headline: The visible section is missing in Menu Bar Layout when the Ice icon is off
issues.symptom: With the Ice icon turned off, the visible section disappeared from the Menu Bar Layout pane.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey splits the sections by the hidden divider, which is always in the menu bar, so the visible section shows with or without the Icey icon.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: is there a way to stop OBS from getting moved to the always hidden section? i've moved it to hidden many times and it still puts itself in always hidden
issues.headline: OBS keeps moving back to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: OBS's item went back to the always-hidden section every time OBS started, however often it was moved to the hidden section.
issues.fix: Icey remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Same as #6 and #732. Applies to macOS 14 to 26. Icey learns the section from v0.14.2 on, so move the item once after updating.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Margin with customization of the menu bar appearance>
issues.headline: More space between the menu bar shape and the screen edge
issues.symptom: A request for a larger margin around the rounded menu bar shape on a MacBook.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Turn on "Use inset shape on screens with notch" in the menu bar appearance editor.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Secondary menu bar>
issues.headline: Show hidden items in a second bar below the menu bar
issues.symptom: A request for a second bar under the menu bar for hidden items, as in Bartender.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Missing "Menu Bar Items" submenu
issues.headline: No pane to arrange menu bar items in Settings
issues.symptom: The settings pane for arranging items was missing from Ice 0.9.
issues.fix: The pane was still in beta at the time. Icey has it as Settings > Menu Bar Layout.
issues.note: Same as #167.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice icon remains visible in task switcher after interacting with Ice menu item
issues.headline: Ice's icon stays in the app switcher after hiding items
issues.symptom: After showing and hiding the hidden and always-hidden sections, Ice's icon stayed in the Dock and the app switcher. It happened when the smart rehide hid the items.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey gives the application menus back and leaves the Dock as soon as no section is shown, however the section was hidden.

issues.title: [Bug]: CPU spike every 1m20s
issues.headline: CPU spikes every minute or so
issues.symptom: Ice's CPU use jumped for about 12 seconds every 1 minute 20 seconds.
issues.fix: Ice reduced the spikes before Icey. Icey also stops the periodic menu bar captures and polling that kept running in the background.
issues.note: Same as #479.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden items are treated as Always hidden?
issues.headline: Hidden items only show with Option-click
issues.symptom: Hidden items only appeared with Option-click, as if they were always-hidden.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The hidden section's divider had been dragged left of the always-hidden one. Icey keeps the dividers in the right order.

issues.title: [Bug]: cannot get screen recording permission in Sequoia
issues.headline: Screen Recording permission can't be granted on macOS 15
issues.symptom: On macOS 15, clicking to grant Screen Recording did nothing, and later Ice still couldn't get the permission after it was added in System Settings.
issues.fix: Ice fixed the missing system prompt before Icey. For an old entry that blocks the permission, click Reset and Ask Again in Icey's permissions window, then allow Icey when macOS asks.
issues.note: The later reports on Ice 0.11.12 match #1004.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice bar drawn under menu bar, under as in 'z-order' under, not below.
issues.headline: The Ice Bar is drawn behind an auto-hiding menu bar
issues.symptom: With the menu bar set to hide automatically, the Ice Bar opened partly behind the menu bar.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Ice 0.10.0 places the Ice Bar below the menu bar, and the reporter confirmed it.

issues.title: [Bug]: Dato menu loads in far left corner instead of being anchored to icon in far right corner
issues.headline: Dato's menu opens at the far left of the screen
issues.symptom: Opening Dato's menu bar item showed its menu in the far left corner instead of under the item.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and a later reporter said it no longer happens. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Icey doesn't choose where an app's menu opens. Dato's upcoming event item moving to the hidden sections is #119.

issues.title: [Bug]: No Menu Bar Items settings section
issues.headline: No pane to arrange menu bar items in Settings
issues.symptom: The settings pane for arranging items, shown in the README, was missing from Ice 0.9.
issues.fix: The pane was still in beta at the time. Icey has it as Settings > Menu Bar Layout.

issues.title: Coming from Bartender problems
issues.headline: Hidden items can't be found after switching from Bartender
issues.symptom: After moving from Bartender to Ice on a MacBook with a notch, the hidden items couldn't be found.
issues.fix: Click the Icey icon to show hidden items, and turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar so they show below the notch. Settings > Menu Bar Layout sets each item's section.

issues.title: [Bug]: Simulated Input Ignored -Little Snitch GUI Scripting access required
issues.headline: Little Snitch blocks Ice from moving its item
issues.symptom: Moving the Little Snitch item failed with "Operation timed out", and Little Snitch warned that it ignored simulated input from Ice.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. If an app that filters simulated mouse input still blocks a move, allow Icey in that app's settings, or quit it while you arrange items.
issues.note: Icey still moves items with simulated mouse events, so security tools that block them can still interfere.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice cannot be configured to allow Little Snitch Mini connection status to be visible in menu bar
issues.headline: Little Snitch Mini's item is always hidden
issues.symptom: Little Snitch Mini's status item never showed while Ice was running, even with all sections shown.
issues.fix: The item fell behind the notch, where macOS hides items. Hide some items, or turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar.
issues.note: Same as #158.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar appearance showing in fullscreen
issues.headline: Menu bar appearance shows in fullscreen
issues.symptom: The menu bar appearance stayed on screen over apps with their own fullscreen mode, such as VLC, and over Keynote presentations.
issues.fix: Icey no longer draws appearance overlays on fullscreen spaces, and hides them while the frontmost app hides the menu bar.
issues.note: Same as #63. VLC's own fullscreen is covered when it hides the menu bar, which is not tested. Turning on VLC's native fullscreen mode avoids it.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide icon from dock
issues.headline: Hide the Ice icon from the Dock
issues.symptom: Ice's icon appeared in the recent apps part of the Dock after every login.
issues.fix: Icey has no Dock icon, except while Settings is open or while it hides the app menus. Turn off Settings > Advanced > Show Icey in the Dock while Settings is open to remove it there too.
issues.note: Same as #161.

issues.title: Update Error: Ice can’t be updated if it’s running from the location it was downloaded to.
issues.headline: "Ice can't be updated if it's running from the location it was downloaded to"
issues.symptom: Checking for updates showed an error saying the app was running from its download location.
issues.fix: Move the app to Applications with Finder and open it from there. If the error stays, delete the app and install it again from the downloaded disk image.
issues.note: macOS runs a quarantined app from a temporary location, and the updater can't replace it there. Updating with a third-party tool such as CleanMyMac can cause the same error.

issues.title: [Bug]: Unable to click or scroll on menu bar for full screen applications on secondary displays
issues.headline: Click and scroll don't show hidden items on a second display
issues.symptom: Show on click and show on scroll did nothing in the menu bar of a second display, in fullscreen apps and on the desktop.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey also uses the display under the pointer for click, scroll and hover.

issues.title: [Bug]: Screen Flicker
issues.headline: Streaming video flickers every few seconds while Ice runs
issues.symptom: Video in Apple TV, Netflix, Hulu and other streaming services flickered or went black about every 5 seconds with a menu bar shape set, and stopped when Ice quit.
issues.fix: Icey now captures the wallpaper only when it changes, or once a minute, instead of every 5 seconds. Setting Menu Bar Appearance > Shape to None stops the captures entirely.
issues.note: Not reproduced with protected video. A capture can still cause a flicker, at most once a minute.

issues.title: [Bug]: Invisible app menu items when using split menu bar shape
issues.headline: App menus right of the notch are invisible with the split shape
issues.symptom: With the split shape, app menus that spilled to the right of the notch were invisible but still clickable.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The reporter confirmed it in Ice 0.10.

issues.title: [Feature Request to the Community]: You came here from Bartender? Reroute your money as well.
issues.headline: Support the developer after leaving Bartender
issues.symptom: A post asking users who switched from Bartender to sponsor Ice's developer.
issues.fix: Concerns upstream's donations. Nothing to fix.

issues.title: [Bug]: hides everything, including itself regardless of settings
issues.headline: Ice hides every item, including its own icon
issues.symptom: After the Ice icon was dragged into the hidden section on a second display, all items disappeared and show on click did nothing.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Later Ice releases made show on click work on every display. To get a hidden Ice icon back, click an empty part of the menu bar, then Command-drag the icon right of the chevron.
issues.note: The report mixes two causes: a second-display bug in Ice 0.8.0, and the Ice icon moved into the hidden section.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar appearance displaying incorrectly on external displays when main display has notch
issues.headline: Menu bar appearance is drawn wrong on an external display when the Mac has a notch
issues.symptom: With a notched built-in display, the split shape and shadow on the other display used the notched menu bar's size, so windows showed through or under it.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Each display now gets its own appearance overlay, sized to that display's menu bar.
issues.note: The split shape glitch on an external display is #102.

issues.title: [Bug]: Show on hover setting does not work
issues.headline: Show on hover does nothing with external displays
issues.symptom: With external displays connected, hovering over the menu bar didn't show the hidden items.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey checks the menu bar of the display under the pointer.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hide the Hidden Section does nothing....
issues.headline: Hiding the hidden section does nothing
issues.symptom: Items next to the Ice icon stayed visible when the hidden section was hidden.
issues.fix: Items right of the first divider are always visible. The hidden section starts left of that divider, not at the Icey icon. Settings > Menu Bar Layout shows which items are in which section.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Explain how to move the icons in the README.md
issues.headline: How to move icons between sections
issues.symptom: Nothing explained that items are moved by Command-dragging them, so new users couldn't arrange them.
issues.fix: The README's Using Icey section explains the sections, Menu Bar Layout and Command-drag. Settings > Menu Bar Layout explains it too.

issues.title: [Bug]: mouse getting captured and moved
issues.headline: The pointer jumps to the top right corner
issues.symptom: The pointer moved to the top right corner of the main display at random while Ice was running.
issues.fix: Caused by another app, Sidebar. Restarting it stopped the problem.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Select items on each sections
issues.headline: Choose which section an item belongs to
issues.symptom: The reporter couldn't find how to put an item in the visible, hidden or always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Drag items between sections in Settings > Menu Bar Layout, or hold Command and drag them in the menu bar.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Make the Screen Recording permission optional
issues.headline: Make the Screen Recording permission optional
issues.symptom: Ice wouldn't open without the Screen Recording permission, even for users who only wanted to hide items.
issues.fix: Available: Screen Recording is optional. Icey hides and shows items with Accessibility alone, and needs Screen Recording only for the menu bar appearance and images of items.
issues.note: Built in Ice before Icey. #415, #270 and #248 point here.

issues.title: [Bug]: Cannot toggle menubar or access Ice menu on non-main display
issues.headline: Clicking the menu bar does nothing on a second display
issues.symptom: With several displays, clicking or right-clicking an empty part of the menu bar only worked on the main display.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey checks the menu bar of the display under the pointer.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Always Show option
issues.headline: Keep some items always visible
issues.symptom: A request for a way to keep some items always shown.
issues.fix: This is the visible section. Command-drag an item to the right of the Ice icon, or drag it to the Visible section in Settings > Menu Bar Layout.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Clicking on an empty space replaces all current menu bar items with the hidden ones
issues.headline: Showing hidden items replaces visible ones
issues.symptom: A request to swap the visible items for the hidden ones on a click, as Bartender does, instead of adding the hidden ones next to them.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #240.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: custom spacing between icons
issues.headline: Adjust the spacing between menu bar items
issues.symptom: A request to change the spacing between menu bar items, as Bartender can.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Use Settings > General > Menu bar item spacing, then click Apply.
issues.note: Same as #304.

issues.title: [Bug]: Show ice icon not working
issues.headline: The Ice icon is gone but its empty space can still be clicked
issues.symptom: After reinstalling, the Ice icon didn't show, though an empty space in the menu bar still responded to clicks.
issues.fix: The Ice icon had been moved into the hidden section. Drag it back to the visible section in Settings > Menu Bar Layout, or Command-drag it right of the hidden section's divider.
issues.note: Icey also saves the icon's position so it no longer lands in the hidden section after a restart (#769).

issues.title: [Bug]: "Hide application menus when showing menu bar items" option doesn't work in some apps.
issues.headline: "Hide application menus" doesn't hide the menus in some apps
issues.symptom: With "Hide application menus when showing menu bar items" on, the menus of some apps, such as Arc, stayed and covered the shown items.
issues.fix: Same as #879. If macOS refuses Icey's request to become the active app, Icey now activates anyway, so the menus hide.
issues.note: Not tested with Arc.

issues.title: Rename Brew cask formula to `ice`
issues.headline: Rename the Homebrew cask to ice
issues.symptom: A request to rename Ice's Homebrew cask from jordanbaird-ice to ice.
issues.fix: Ice's Homebrew cask is maintained upstream. Icey has no Homebrew cask yet, so install it from its releases page.
issues.note: Related to #862.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar shapes didn't appear to work
issues.headline: Menu bar shapes don't work when the menu bar hides automatically
issues.symptom: With the macOS setting that hides the menu bar automatically, the menu bar shape was not drawn correctly.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey: the appearance is no longer drawn while macOS hides the menu bar, so it isn't drawn in the wrong place. Shapes and tint are not shown on a menu bar that hides automatically.
issues.note: Not yet tested with a menu bar that hides automatically. A shape lost until restart after an update is like #409 and #53.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Swipe to see different menu bar areas
issues.headline: Swipe to see menu bar items that don't fit
issues.symptom: A request to swipe between menu bar areas to reach items that don't fit in the menu bar.
issues.fix: Not started. The Ice Bar, in Settings > General > Use Ice Bar, shows hidden items below the menu bar so they don't need room there.
issues.note: Same as #240.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice settings window opens on startup
issues.headline: Settings window opens at startup
issues.symptom: Ice's settings window opened every time Ice started.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The reporter confirmed it in Ice 0.10.2.
issues.note: A later macOS 26 case is #695.

issues.title: High CPU, memory, and energy usage
issues.headline: Ice uses a lot of CPU, memory and energy
issues.symptom: Ice showed high CPU, memory and energy use in Activity Monitor, more so with show on hover turned on.
issues.fix: Same as #479. Icey only listens to mouse events while a setting needs them, polls less and prunes its image cache, so it stays near zero energy impact while idle.

issues.title: Menu bar appearance overlay is displayed when Firefox is fullscreen
issues.headline: Menu bar tint shows over a fullscreen Firefox video
issues.symptom: The menu bar appearance overlay stayed on screen while Firefox, Safari or OneNote was fullscreen.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Ice reworked its fullscreen check, and the reporter confirmed the overlay no longer shows.
issues.note: Icey hides each display's overlay while that display is fullscreen. See also #468 and #544.

issues.title: About "Menu bar items are rehidden after a fixed time of 30 seconds."
issues.headline: Rehide items after more than 30 seconds
issues.symptom: The timed rehide setting stops at 30 seconds, and a request asked for up to 5 minutes.
issues.fix: Settings > General > Automatically rehide, with the Timed strategy, now goes up to five minutes.

issues.title: menu bar appearance changes back to standard design after using full screen app
issues.headline: Menu bar appearance resets after using a fullscreen app
issues.symptom: After leaving a fullscreen app, the menu bar went back to the standard look until Ice restarted.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, which reworked its fullscreen check. Icey also fixed how it detects fullscreen spaces.

issues.title: Multi-monitor support
issues.headline: Menu bar shape only shows on the main display
issues.symptom: The split or rounded menu bar shape appeared on the main display but not on a second display.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Ice 0.8.0 draws the appearance on every display, and the reporter confirmed it.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Use modifier key + click on empty area to show "always hidden" section
issues.headline: Option-click an empty menu bar area to show always-hidden items
issues.symptom: A request to show the always-hidden section by Option-clicking an empty part of the menu bar.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. With show on click on, Option-click an empty part of the menu bar.

issues.title: apps are moved to always hidden section
issues.headline: Some apps move to the always-hidden section after every restart
issues.symptom: After every restart, 1Password, Dropbox, MEGA and Hammerspoon items were in the always-hidden section, even after being moved back.
issues.fix: Same as #732. Icey remembers each item's section, so an item an app puts back at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Applies to macOS 14 to 26. Upstream closed this in favor of jordanbaird/Ice#6.

issues.title: App doesn't show all the icons when another app is in focus.
issues.headline: App menus cover menu bar items
issues.symptom: When another app was active, its menus overlapped the menu bar items and some couldn't be reached.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Turn on Settings > Advanced > Hide app menus when showing menu bar items, which hides the app menus only when they are in the way.
issues.note: Same cause as #416.

issues.title: Showing the Ice Icon and the hidden indicators together isn't nessecary
issues.headline: Section arrows show next to the Ice icon
issues.symptom: When hidden items were shown, an arrow for each section appeared next to the Ice icon and took up space.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Settings > Advanced > Section divider style can be set to None, which is the default.

issues.title: Automatically rehide on "focused app" an multiple displays collide
issues.headline: "Focused app" rehide hides items when you click the menu bar on another display
issues.symptom: With the "Focused app" rehide setting and two displays, clicking the menu bar of the inactive display showed the items for a moment, then hid them again.
issues.fix: Icey checks the menu bar of the display under the pointer, not only the active one, before it rehides on an app switch.
issues.note: Not yet tested on two displays. The redrawing in the reporter's video is #241.

issues.title: [Bug]: The app doesn't start unless permissions are manually granted
issues.headline: Ice quits at launch until permissions are granted by hand
issues.symptom: Ice closed after its update prompt and never asked for permissions. It only worked after Accessibility and Screen Recording were granted by hand in System Settings.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey opens its permissions window at launch when a permission is missing.
issues.note: If macOS says a permission is on but Icey still asks, see #1004.

issues.title: Ice causing DRM media playback to flicker
issues.headline: Streaming video flickers while Ice runs
issues.symptom: Apple TV and Prime Video flickered, and Prime Video said the Mac didn't meet content protection standards, until Ice quit.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey for the reported case: Icey only captures the screen when a menu bar shape needs the wallpaper. With the full or split shape, see #105.

issues.title: Launch at Login does not work (Ice 0.5.0, Sonoma 14.3.1)
issues.headline: Launch at login doesn't start Ice
issues.symptom: With Launch at Login turned on, Ice didn't start after a restart.
issues.fix: macOS had lost track of the app's location. Reinstalling it in Applications and turning Launch at Login on again fixed it.

issues.title: [Feature Request] configurable automatically hide time
issues.headline: Choose how long before items hide again
issues.symptom: A request to set the time before hidden items hide again, and a shortcut to pause automatic hiding.
issues.fix: Turn on Settings > General > Automatically rehide, choose the Timed strategy and set the interval. Settings > Hotkeys > Toggle automatic rehiding, or the icey://toggle-auto-rehide link, pauses it.

issues.title: Hidden Menu disappears when you click to make it re-appear in Dark Mode / Sonoma 14.3.1
issues.headline: Hidden items disappear when you click the Ice icon with the split shape
issues.symptom: With the split menu bar shape on, clicking the Ice icon hid the menu bar items instead of showing them, mostly in dark mode.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Ice 0.6.2 changed how the split shape is drawn, and the reporter confirmed the fix.

issues.title: Hovering menubar keeps showing icons
issues.headline: Show on hover keeps items shown with two displays
issues.symptom: With two displays, items stayed shown after the pointer left the menu bar for the other display, and hovering an inactive display's menu bar showed them.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey: items hide when the pointer leaves the menu bar on any display. Icey shows hidden items on hover over any display's menu bar, including an inactive one, on purpose.
issues.note: Limiting hover to the active display is not planned. macOS shows the same items on every display (#683).

issues.title: Spiking CPU usage
issues.headline: Ice uses a lot of CPU
issues.symptom: Ice used about 6% CPU while idle and up to 20% when the pointer was over the menu bar.
issues.fix: Ice lowered its CPU use before Icey. Icey also stops listening to mouse events it doesn't need and removes background polling, so it stays near zero while idle.
issues.note: Same as #479.

issues.title: [Bug Report] Gradient Borders showing up in Full Screen.
issues.headline: Menu bar tint shows in fullscreen apps
issues.symptom: The menu bar tint and gradient showed over fullscreen apps.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey hides its menu bar styling in fullscreen spaces.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Search Menu Bar Items
issues.headline: Search menu bar items
issues.symptom: A request for a search panel that finds a menu bar item and opens it, like Bartender's.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Open the search panel from Icey's menu or with its hotkey in Settings > Hotkeys.

issues.title: [Feature Request] notch macbook support.
issues.headline: Hidden items are lost behind the notch on a MacBook
issues.symptom: On a MacBook with a notch, items that didn't fit next to the notch could not be seen, even when shown.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar to show hidden items in a bar below the menu bar. Icey can also use the Ice Bar only on displays with a notch.

issues.fix: Icey includes macOS 27 support: hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor work.
issues.note: Same as #954.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu bar doesn't reflect the correct visible and hidden icons
issues.headline: Hidden and visible items look swapped
issues.symptom: The reporter thought the visible and hidden sections were swapped.
issues.fix: The reporter had mixed up the two sections and withdrew the report.

issues.title: [Bug]:
issues.headline: Sound and Wi-Fi items are far apart with default spacing
issues.symptom: With the default item spacing, app items sat closer together and the Sound and Wi-Fi items further apart.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Faster renewal
issues.headline: Live values in the Ice Bar lag behind
issues.symptom: Live values such as the time or the CPU load showed late in the Ice Bar.
issues.fix: The Ice Bar shows pictures of the items. Icey takes new ones every 3 seconds while the Ice Bar is open, so live values can be up to 3 seconds old.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Make Dock Icon Hide
issues.headline: Hide Icey's Dock icon
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for an option to hide the Dock icon.
issues.fix: Available: Icey shows its Dock icon only while the Settings window is open.
issues.note: Same as #116.

issues.title: [Bug]: macos 26.3.1 app crashed
issues.headline: Ice crashes when you click the expand icon on macOS 26.3
issues.symptom: Ice 0.11.12 crashed when the expand icon was clicked on macOS 26.3.1.
issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.
issues.note: Same as #740.

issues.title: [ICE] 260308 - Average-colour calculation divides by zero for fully transparent images
issues.headline: A fully transparent image breaks the average color
issues.symptom: The average color of a fully transparent image was computed by dividing by zero, which gave a color with invalid components.
issues.fix: Icey returns no color for an image without visible pixels.
issues.note: Filed from a code review, not from a user report.

issues.title: [ICE] 260308 - The XPC service accepts unrestricted clients on pre-macOS 26 systems
issues.headline: Other processes can connect to the menu bar item service
issues.symptom: A code review said the menu bar item helper accepts any client before macOS 26.
issues.fix: macOS lets only the app that contains an XPC service connect to it, so other processes can't reach it. macOS 26 and later also check the client's signature.
issues.note: Filed from a code review, not from a user report.

issues.title: [ICE] 260308 - Screen capture permission detection returns false after inspecting only one window
issues.headline: Screen Recording is reported missing although it is granted
issues.symptom: The permission check looked only at the first menu bar item of another app. An item without a title made Ice report the permission as missing.
issues.fix: Icey counts the permission as granted when any item has a title, and still notices when it is revoked.
issues.note: Filed from a code review, not from a user report.

issues.title: [ICE] 260308 - Menu bar items are keyed by a non-unique tag and can collide
issues.headline: Items from one app with the same name get mixed up
issues.symptom: Items were told apart by app and title only, so two items from one app with the same title shared images, moves and rehiding.
issues.fix: Icey tells identical items apart by their window when moving, showing and rehiding them. Images are still stored by app and title.
issues.note: Filed from a code review, not from a user report. See #857.

issues.title: [ICE] 260308 - Screen recording permission state stays stale until relaunch
issues.headline: Screen Recording stays missing until Ice restarts
issues.symptom: A missing permission was remembered, so granting it while Ice ran didn't unblock Menu Bar Layout or the Ice Bar.
issues.fix: Icey remembers only a granted permission, so one granted while it runs is picked up.
issues.note: Filed from a code review, not from a user report.

issues.title: [Bug]: Cannot move Sharing (Remote Management) menu bar icon across sections — "Missing bounds rectangle"
issues.headline: The Sharing item can't be moved
issues.symptom: The Sharing (Remote Management) item with binoculars couldn't be moved to the hidden section, by Ice or by Command-dragging it.
issues.fix: macOS doesn't let this item be moved, also not by Command-dragging it, so Icey can't hide it. Turn off the sharing service, or keep the item visible.

issues.title: [Bug]: My formal icons are lost and can't be foud after dragging them into the visible part of menu bar layout

issues.fix: macOS 26 turned the app off in System Settings > Menu Bar. Turn it back on under Allow in the Menu Bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: ICE crashes on Tahoe 26.2 (and .1) if you set "Use ice bar" option.
issues.headline: Ice crashes on macOS 26.2 with the Ice Bar

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice consuming too much RAM
issues.headline: Ice uses a lot of memory

issues.title: [Bug]: Operation timed out for "SSMainAppMenuIcon"

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Possible to have Ice Bar w/ responsive Ice Menu Icon?

issues.fix: Icey is built on the macOS 26 code, and the conversion that crashed is gone.
