issues.fix: The reporter's macOS beta caused it. It went away after leaving the beta.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Ability to remove right click on menubar
issues.headline: Turn off the menu that appears when you right-click the menu bar
issues.symptom: The reporter asked to turn off Ice's menu on right-clicks in empty menu bar space, which other apps and games use.
issues.fix: Available: turn off Settings > Advanced > Enable secondary context menu.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Bar only functional when settings app is launched
issues.headline: The Ice Bar works only while Settings is open
issues.symptom: Clicking items in the Ice Bar did nothing unless the Settings window was open.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: The reporter fixed it by reinstalling and granting the permissions again.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Use Ice Bar - ON. Need tiny black contour around shape and maybe shadow of Ice Bar. Or it feels merged with background
issues.headline: Outline and shadow for the Ice Bar
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for an outline and shadow so the Ice Bar stands out from the background.
issues.fix: Available: the Ice Bar has a shadow, and the border from Settings > Menu Bar Appearance is drawn around it too.

issues.title: [Bug]: Sqeuoia 15.1.1 breaks Menu Bar Appearance
issues.headline: Menu bar appearance stops working after a macOS update
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 15.1.1, the menu bar appearance settings had no effect.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Quitting and reopening Ice fixed it for the reporter.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu Spacing is not consistent
issues.headline: Item spacing is uneven
issues.symptom: With a smaller item spacing, the gaps between items were uneven.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: A restart fixed it for the reporter.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Multiple Style Options For Dynamic Light/Dark Mode Wallpaper
issues.headline: Different menu bar appearance in light and dark mode
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for separate tint, shadow and border settings for light and dark mode.
issues.fix: Available: turn on Use dynamic appearance in Settings > Menu Bar Appearance, then set the light and dark appearances separately.

issues.title: [Bug]: Sequoia stuck during install
issues.headline: Grant Permissions buttons don't respond during setup
issues.symptom: On macOS 15.0, the Grant Permissions buttons in the setup window didn't open System Settings.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, in Ice 0.11.7.

issues.title: [Bug]: Can't move items to an empty menu bar section
issues.headline: Items can't be dropped into an empty section
issues.symptom: An empty section in Menu Bar Layout said "Unable to display menu bar items" and took no items.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. An empty section takes dropped items.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: work without screen record permission
issues.headline: Use Icey without Screen Recording
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for Ice to work without Screen Recording, for privacy.
issues.fix: Available: Screen Recording is optional. Hiding and showing items work without it. Menu Bar Layout, item pictures and the menu bar's color need it.

issues.title: [Bug]: Drag in Settings from Visible Menu Bar to Hidden Menu Bar does update the actual menubar
issues.headline: Moves in Menu Bar Layout don't reach the menu bar
issues.symptom: An item dragged to the hidden section in Menu Bar Layout stayed visible in the menu bar.
issues.fix: Don't hold Command while dragging in Menu Bar Layout. It makes the menu bar intercept the events Icey sends.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Handle Ctrl-LeftClick on Ice icon as a RightClick
issues.headline: Control-click the Icey icon to open its menu
issues.symptom: Control-clicking the Ice icon showed the hidden items instead of the menu, so trackpad users couldn't open the menu.
issues.fix: Available: Control-clicking the Icey icon opens its menu.

issues.title: Why items are moved without user input
issues.headline: Why items move to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: An explanation of why items moved to the always-hidden section without the user moving them.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden. Icey also remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: When quitting an app with an icon in the Ice Bar, Ice takes a while to realize it's gone
issues.headline: The Ice Bar shows an item after its app has quit
issues.symptom: After an app with an item in the Ice Bar quit, the Ice Bar kept showing the item for a while.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. The Ice Bar checks the menu bar items each time it opens.

issues.title: [Bug]: Many Alfred Icons
issues.headline: Many copies of one item in the hidden items
issues.symptom: Several copies of Alfred's item showed in the hidden items, and clicking one crashed Ice.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, in Ice 0.10.5.

issues.title: [Bug]: When program restart, The program icon will break away from Ice.
issues.headline: An app's item breaks after the app restarts
issues.symptom: After JetBrains Toolbox was quit and opened again, its item showed wrongly in Settings.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: restore Ice Bar settings option to choose the location of the Hidden items bar
issues.headline: Choose where the Ice Bar opens
issues.symptom: The reporter asked to bring back the option for where the Ice Bar opens.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > General > Location, under Use Ice Bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Bar shows when selecting the  menu on the far right side of the screen.
issues.headline: The Ice Bar opens with the Apple menu
issues.symptom: With show on click, opening the Apple menu at the top-left corner also opened the Ice Bar.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Clicks on the application menus, from the screen's left edge, don't show the hidden items.

issues.title: [Bug]: "Help" menu label not showing on left menu in Evernote with split menu on Mac Sonoma 14.5
issues.headline: The Help menu is missing with the split menu bar shape
issues.symptom: With the split menu bar shape, Evernote's Help menu didn't show.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden icon in Ice Bar remains visible in main menu bar after clicking it
issues.headline: An item opened from the Ice Bar stays in the menu bar
issues.symptom: An item clicked in the Ice Bar stayed in the menu bar and wasn't hidden again.
issues.fix: After hiding a shown item again, Icey checks that it is back in its section and moves it there if not.
issues.note: Same as #729.

issues.title: languages choose
issues.headline: Choose Icey's language
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for a Chinese version and a way to choose the language.
issues.fix: Available: Icey is translated into English and nine other languages, including Simplified Chinese. To use a language other than the system's, choose it in System Settings > General > Language & Region > Applications.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Customizable show/hide delay
issues.headline: Set the delay before items show
issues.symptom: The reporter asked to make the delay before items show on hover shorter.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > Advanced > Show on hover delay.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu Bar Items are not visible immediately
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is empty at first
issues.symptom: The first time Settings opened, Menu Bar Layout said "Unable to display menu bar items" until the window was clicked.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu Bar Glitches when using a second Display
issues.headline: The menu bar looks cut off with a second display
issues.symptom: With a second display connected, Ice's menu bar appearance looked cut off.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, in Ice 0.10.0.

issues.title: [Bug]: Right-click context menu appears when it shouldn’t; doesn’t appear when it should
issues.headline: Ice's right-click menu appears in full screen
issues.symptom: Ice's right-click menu showed over full-screen apps on a second display, and not when it should on the built-in one.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey, in Ice 0.10.0.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Hidden/missing menu bar items and icon reorganization with notch>
issues.headline: Items behind the notch can't be arranged
issues.symptom: On a MacBook with a notch, items past the notch couldn't be seen or arranged.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > Menu Bar Layout arranges every item, and Settings > General > Use Ice Bar shows hidden items below the menu bar.
issues.note: Same as #1.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Menu bar layout customisation
issues.headline: Show items below the menu bar and arrange them
issues.symptom: The reporter asked to show items below the menu bar and to arrange them.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > General > Use Ice Bar, and Settings > Menu Bar Layout.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden section not showing
issues.headline: The hidden section doesn't show
issues.symptom: Showing the hidden section did nothing, while showing the always-hidden section showed every item.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey keeps its dividers in order, so the hidden divider can't end up left of the always-hidden one.

issues.title: [Bug]: Slight white tint on place where menu bar is when window is tiled (not sure if bug or macOS thing)
issues.headline: A light line under the menu bar next to tiled windows
issues.symptom: With a menu bar shape, a light line showed where the menu bar ends above tiled windows on macOS 15.
issues.fix: That is the tiled window's shadow, drawn by macOS. Turn off System Settings > Desktop & Dock > Tiled windows have margins.

issues.title: How do I update existing translation?
issues.headline: How to update a translation
issues.symptom: A question about where Ice's translations are, posted to the wrong project.
issues.fix: Icey's translations are in Ice/Localizable.xcstrings. Pull requests are welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: If "Enable the always-hidden section" is disabled, it should also disable the option-click feature and menubar item
issues.headline: Option-click shows an empty bar with the always-hidden section off
issues.symptom: With the always-hidden section off, Option-clicking the Ice icon still showed an empty bar.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Option-click shows the always-hidden section only while it is on.

issues.title: [Bug]: Always Hidden Icebar does not auto hide
issues.headline: The always-hidden Ice Bar doesn't hide again
issues.symptom: The Ice Bar opened for the always-hidden section never hid by itself.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Automatic rehiding applies to both sections.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice Bar doesn't update if always-hidden section is disabled
issues.headline: The Ice Bar doesn't update with the always-hidden section off
issues.symptom: With the always-hidden section off, the Ice Bar didn't pick up items that were added or removed.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Icey reads the items without the always-hidden divider.

issues.title: [Bug]: Some icons moved back to "always hidden" upon inactivity
issues.headline: Discord's voice item goes back to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: Discord's voice item, moved to the visible section, was back in the always-hidden section after leaving and joining a call.
issues.fix: Icey remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Same as #207.

issues.title: [Bug]: fails to hide menus
issues.headline: App menus aren't hidden when the always-hidden section shows
issues.symptom: Showing the always-hidden items sometimes left the app's menus in place although there wasn't room.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Icon for Flow (pomodoro timer) is not visible
issues.headline: Flow's timer item is missing
issues.symptom: Flow's timer item didn't show while Ice ran.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden. Icey also remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Margin around menu bar
issues.headline: Margins around the menu bar
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for space between the menu bar and the screen's edges, for a floating look.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Always-hidden section bug>
issues.headline: An item goes back to the always-hidden section after a restart
issues.symptom: An item moved out of the always-hidden section was back there after restarting the Mac.
issues.fix: Icey remembers each item's section, so an item an app puts back at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Same as #29.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Ability to choose none icon
issues.headline: Hide the Icey icon
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for no icon at all.
issues.fix: Available: turn off Settings > General > Show Icey icon.

issues.title: Ice does not properly remember app order
issues.headline: Items don't keep their order within a section
issues.symptom: Items in one section came back in a different order after their apps were quit and opened again.
issues.fix: Not started. Icey keeps each item's section, but not its place within the section. See #26.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice and Loop do NOT work together.
issues.headline: Loop's item is missing
issues.symptom: Loop's item didn't show while Ice ran.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden. Icey also remembers each item's section, so an item an app creates again at the far left is moved back to where it was.
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Ice section hierarchy deadlock solutions
issues.headline: Keep Icey's dividers in order
issues.symptom: Rearranging items could put the always-hidden divider right of the hidden one, which hid the Ice icon.
issues.fix: Available: Icey puts its dividers back in order when they get swapped.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hover and click gestures are not compatible with Lickable Menu Bar
issues.headline: Show on hover and click don't work with Lickable Menu Bar
issues.symptom: With Lickable Menu Bar running, show on hover and show on click stopped working.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: The Ice icon disappeared and cannot be brought up via the "Show Ice icon" option
issues.headline: The Icey icon is missing
issues.symptom: The Ice icon seemed gone, and only a divider showed.
issues.fix: Bartender had moved the Ice icon into a hidden section. Command-drag it back.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide Dock Icon
issues.headline: Hide Icey's Dock icon
issues.symptom: The reporter asked to hide the Dock icon.
issues.fix: Available: Icey shows its Dock icon only while the Settings window is open.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: state system requirements clearly on the website and in the README
issues.headline: State the system requirements
issues.symptom: The website and README didn't say which macOS versions Ice needs.
issues.fix: Icey's README and website say it runs on macOS 14 and later.

issues.title: [Bug]: Not working on external monitors
issues.headline: Hidden items don't show on an external display
issues.symptom: Show on click and show on hover worked only on the built-in display.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Lack of sync between displays
issues.headline: Sections don't toggle on every display
issues.symptom: Sections shown or hidden on one display didn't change on the other, and a hotkey moved focus to the main display.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey for showing and hiding.
issues.note: The focus change was to be filed separately, and wasn't.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: not a request
issues.headline: Thanks
issues.symptom: A thank-you note.
issues.fix: Not a bug.

issues.title: [Bug]: Items automatically get re-hidden even with disabling the feature
issues.headline: Items are hidden again with automatic rehiding off
issues.symptom: Items shown from the hidden section were hidden again with automatic rehiding off.
issues.fix: Items opened from the Ice Bar or search are hidden again after Settings > Advanced > Temporarily shown item delay, which is separate from automatic rehiding.

issues.title: [Bug]: Limit on the number of icons that can be shown
issues.headline: Some hidden items never show
issues.symptom: On a MacBook with a notch, hidden items that didn't fit never showed.
issues.fix: Turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar to show hidden items in a bar below the menu bar.
issues.note: Same as #1.

issues.title: [Bug]: Not showing multiple identical icons
issues.headline: Identical items show only once
issues.symptom: With two OneDrive accounts, only one of the two OneDrive items showed.
issues.fix: Icey tells identical items from one app apart by their window.
issues.note: Same as #857.

issues.title: [Bug]: Potential Issue with Spaces
issues.headline: replayd crashes while switching spaces
issues.symptom: replayd crashed several times while switching quickly between many spaces.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.

issues.title: How to control which section (hidden, always hidden) apps are assigned to?
issues.headline: Choose which section an item is in
issues.symptom: A question how to put items in the visible or always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Drag items between sections in Settings > Menu Bar Layout, or Command-drag them in the menu bar.

issues.title: Remove Sparkle Sandboxing configuration because app is not sandboxed
issues.headline: Sparkle warning about a changed downloader
issues.symptom: Ice used Sparkle's sandbox settings although it isn't sandboxed, which can show a one-time warning on macOS 14.
issues.fix: Icey doesn't use Sparkle's sandbox settings.

issues.title: Fix menu bar appearance when using multiple displays
issues.headline: Menu bar appearance jumps between displays
issues.symptom: Ice's menu bar appearance jumped between displays or disappeared.
issues.fix: Fixed in Ice before Icey. Each display has its own appearance panels.

issues.title: Feature to show no icon to indicate hidden icons
issues.headline: Hide the Icey icon
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for no icon, with clicks on empty menu bar space instead.
issues.fix: Available: turn off Settings > General > Show Icey icon, and use show on click or the right-click menu.
issues.note: Same as #175.

issues.title: Feature to show items on clicking the menubar
issues.headline: Show items by clicking the menu bar
issues.symptom: The reporter asked to show hidden items by clicking empty menu bar space.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > General > Show on click.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Let us customize bar/settings when we right click it
issues.headline: A menu when you right-click the menu bar
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for a menu when right-clicking the menu bar.
issues.fix: Available: right-click empty menu bar space. Settings > Advanced > Enable secondary context menu turns it on or off.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Add Ice to Homebrew
issues.headline: Install Icey with Homebrew
issues.symptom: The reporter asked for a Homebrew cask.
issues.fix: Not started for Icey. Download it from the releases page.

issues.title: FR: Handling low resolutions with long application menus
issues.headline: Too many items for a low resolution
issues.symptom: At a low resolution, items past the app menus couldn't be reached.
issues.fix: Available: turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar to show hidden items in a bar below the menu bar.
issues.note: Same as #1.
